openers.prompt_en: A school display uses every second even locker number: 12, 16, 20, … Which two locker numbers come next?
openers.prompt_hi: School display mein har doosra even locker number liya hai: 12, 16, 20, … Agle do locker numbers kaun se hain?
hints: How far apart are the displayed locker numbers?
Every second even number means one even number is skipped.
After 20, the next displayed number is 20 + ___; repeat.
24 and 28; each displayed number is 4 more.

openers.prompt_en: A triangular arrangement of seats grows by adding a new row each time. Its totals are 6, 10, 15, … How many seats are in the next arrangement?
openers.prompt_hi: Seats ki triangular arrangement mein har baar ek nayi row judti hai. Totals 6, 10, 15, … hain. Agli arrangement mein kitni seats hongi?
hints: How many seats were added between the last two arrangements?
Each new row has one more seat than the previous new row.
The next total is 15 + ___.
21 seats; the new row adds 6.

harder.prompt_en: For a game, Meera writes every odd number from 31 through 49, including both ends. How many numbers does she write?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek game ke liye Meera 31 se 49 tak saare odd numbers likhti hai, dono ends ko milaakar. Woh kitne numbers likhti hai?
hints: What is the gap between consecutive odd numbers?
Count the equal gaps first, then include the starting number.
Number of terms = (49 − 31) ÷ ___ + 1.
10 numbers; there are nine gaps and one starting number.

harder.prompt_en: A triangular display has 28 lights in seven rows: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 7. If the organisers add two more rows, how many lights will it have?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek triangular display ki saat rows mein 28 lights hain: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 7. Organisers do aur rows jod dein, toh total kitni lights hongi?
hints: How many lights go in each of the two new rows?
Continue the row sizes after the seventh row.
New total = 28 + ___ + ___.
45 lights; rows of 8 and 9 are added.

harder.prompt_en: A game awards points in this sequence: 1, 8, 27, 64, 125. What rule gives the points for level n?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek game mein points ka sequence hai: 1, 8, 27, 64, 125. Level n ke points nikaalne ka rule kya hai?
acceptable: multiply n by itself three times
hints: Could each term depend on its level number?
Compare a term with repeated multiplication of its level number.
Points at level n = n × ___ × ___.
Cube n: multiply the level number by itself three times.

openers.prompt_en: A school stage display uses 21 lights to make a triangular-number picture, with one light in the top row. How many lights should be in each row, from top to bottom?
openers.prompt_hi: School stage par 21 lights ka triangular-number picture banana hai, upar ki row mein ek light hai. Upar se neeche tak har row mein kitni lights hongi?
acceptable: one, two, three, four, five, six
ek, do, teen, chaar, paanch, chhah
hints: How does each new row compare with the row above?
In this triangle, each lower row has one more light.
Start at the top: 1, 2, 3, ___; stop when the total reaches 21.
1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6; these rows total 21.

openers.prompt_en: A game screen shows dots in a 3-by-3 square. You add one new row and one new column to make a 4-by-4 square. How many new dots are needed?
openers.prompt_hi: Game screen par dots ka 3-by-3 square hai. Use 4-by-4 square banane ke liye ek nayi row aur ek naya column jodte ho. Kitne naye dots chahiye?
hints: Where would you draw the new row and column?
Count their dots, but watch where they meet.
New dots = row + column − shared dot = ___.
7 dots; the new row and column share one corner dot.

harder.prompt_en: A school noticeboard has 28 pins. Which arrangement shows 28 as a triangular number: A, rows of 1 through 7 pins; or B, four equal rows of 7 pins?
harder.prompt_hi: School noticeboard par 28 pins hain. Kaunsa arrangement 28 ko triangular number dikhata hai: A, 1 se 7 pins wali rows; ya B, 7 pins ki chaar barabar rows?
hints: Which arrangement gets wider one row at a time?
A triangular dot picture grows by one dot in each successive row.
Choose the arrangement with row lengths ___ to ___.
A; its rows increase from 1 to 7 and total 28.

harder.prompt_en: A phone game shows a 12-by-12 square of dots. To grow it into a 13-by-13 square, a player adds a row and a column. How many dots are added?
harder.prompt_hi: Phone game mein dots ka 12-by-12 square hai. Use 13-by-13 banane ke liye ek row aur ek column jodte hain. Kitne dots judenge?
hints: Will the new row and column have a dot in common?
Count both new edges, then correct for their shared corner.
Dots added = new row + new column − shared corner = ___.
25 dots; two edges of 13 share one corner.

harder.prompt_en: To grow an 8-by-8 tile square into a 9-by-9 square, Arjun draws a new row of 9 and a new column of 9. Why does adding 9 + 9 give one tile too many?
harder.prompt_hi: 8-by-8 tiles ka square 9-by-9 banane ke liye Arjun 9 tiles ki nayi row aur 9 tiles ka naya column banata hai. 9 + 9 ginne par ek tile zyada kyun aata hai?
harder.answer: The new row and column share a corner tile, which gets counted twice.
acceptable: One tile belongs to both the row and column
common corner ko do baar gina
hints: Do the new row and new column touch?
Look at the corner where the two new edges meet.
The tile at their meeting point is counted ___.
Their shared corner tile is counted twice, so subtract one.

verified.solverAnswer: The corner tile is counted twice.

openers.prompt_en: A square rangoli has 5 rows of 5 dots. Meera extends it to 6 rows of 6 dots by adding dots along the bottom and right edges. How many dots does she add?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek square rangoli mein 5 rows hain, har row mein 5 dots. Meera neeche aur daayein kinaare par dots jodkar use 6 rows aur 6 columns ka banati hai. Kitne dots judte hain?
hints: Which dots belong to the new border?
Think of the border as the next odd-sized layer.
New dots = new square’s dots − old square’s dots = ___.
11 dots: the 6 × 6 square has 11 more than the 5 × 5 square.

openers.prompt_en: For a school display, one triangular arrangement has 10 badges in 4 rows; the next has 15 badges in 5 rows. If the two arrangements fit together to form a square, how many badges are in that square?
openers.prompt_hi: School display mein ek triangular arrangement ki 4 rows mein 10 badges hain; agle arrangement ki 5 rows mein 15 badges hain. Dono milkar square banate hain. Us square mein kitne badges hain?
hints: What must you combine to count the square?
The two triangles are consecutive triangular numbers.
Badges in the square = badges in both triangles added = ___.
25 badges: the two arrangements together form a 5 × 5 square.

harder.prompt_en: A stadium lights a square grid in stages: first 1 light, then 3 more, then 5 more, continuing through 29 more. How many lights are on? Use the pattern rather than adding every number.
harder.prompt_hi: Stadium mein square grid ki lights stages mein jalti hain: pehle 1, phir 3 aur, phir 5 aur, aise hi 29 aur tak. Kul kitni lights jalengi? Sab numbers alag-alag jodne ke bajay pattern use karo.
hints: Which stage ends with the given odd number?
Each new odd layer makes the square’s side one longer.
Number of odd layers = ___; square that number.
225 lights: there are 15 odd layers, making a 15 × 15 square.

harder.prompt_en: At a kabaddi event, two consecutive triangular seating sections have 12 and 13 rows. They join to make a square seating block. How many seats are in the block?
harder.prompt_hi: Kabaddi event mein do lagataar triangular seating sections ki 12 aur 13 rows hain. Dono judkar square seating block banate hain. Block mein kul kitni seats hain?
hints: What is the side length of the joined square?
Consecutive triangles with these row counts complete a square.
Seats in the block = square of ___ rows.
169 seats: the sections join into a 13 × 13 square.

harder.prompt_en: A phone game adds dots in L-shaped layers: 1, then 3, then 5, and so on. Which explains why every total is square: A) Each new L completes a larger square; B) Any sum of odd numbers is square?
harder.prompt_hi: Phone game mein dots L-shape layers mein judte hain: pehle 1, phir 3, phir 5, aur aise hi. Har total square kyun hai? A) Har naya L bada square poora karta hai; B) Odd numbers ka koi bhi sum square hota hai?
harder.answer: A — Each new L completes a larger square
acceptable: Each new L completes a larger square
Har naya L bada square poora karta hai
hints: How does the dot picture change after each move?
Focus on the shape made by all dots, not just their count.
Each added layer fills the border of a larger ___.
A: each new L completes a larger square, so every total is square.

openers.prompt_en: For a school display, Meera arranges regular polygon tiles in this order: triangle, square, pentagon, hexagon. How many sides and corners will the next tile have?
openers.prompt_hi: School display ke liye Meera regular polygon tiles is order mein lagati hai: triangle, square, pentagon, hexagon. Agli tile ke kitne sides aur corners honge?
hints: Each new tile changes the side count by how much?
Compare consecutive tiles, then check their corners.
After the hexagon, sides = ___ and corners = ___.
7 sides and 7 corners; each tile adds one side and one corner.

openers.prompt_en: Four students mark four points on a noticeboard and draw one straight line joining every pair of points. How many lines do they draw?
openers.prompt_hi: Chaar students noticeboard par chaar points mark karte hain aur har pair ko ek straight line se jodte hain. Total kitni lines banengi?
hints: Which pairs can you make starting from the first point?
Count each pair once; reversing a pair makes no new line.
Lines from successive points: ___ + ___ + ___.
6 lines; the points contribute 3, then 2, then 1 new line.

harder.prompt_en: A geometry app lists regular polygons by number of sides: position 1 is a triangle, position 2 a square, position 3 a pentagon. How many corners has the polygon at position 12?
harder.prompt_hi: Geometry app regular polygons ko sides ke hisaab se list karta hai: position 1 par triangle, position 2 par square, position 3 par pentagon hai. Position 12 wale polygon ke kitne corners honge?
hints: How does the side count compare with the position number?
Find the side count first; corners match sides.
At position 12, corners = 12 + ___.
14 corners; the side count is two more than the position.

harder.prompt_en: At a school exhibition, 8 display points are marked. A string joins every pair of points exactly once. How many strings are needed?
harder.prompt_hi: School exhibition mein 8 display points mark kiye gaye hain. Har pair ko ek hi string se joda jaata hai. Kitni strings chahiye?
hints: How many new strings does each successive point add?
Count pairs once, rather than once from each endpoint.
Total strings = 7 + 6 + 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + ___.
28 strings; adding the new connections gives 7 + 6 + … + 1.

harder.prompt_en: In a Koch snowflake design, each small straight segment becomes four smaller segments at every stage. The first three stages have 3, 12 and 48 segments. How many segments will stage 5 have?
harder.prompt_hi: Koch snowflake design mein har stage par ek chhota straight segment chaar chhote segments ban jaata hai. Pehle teen stages mein 3, 12 aur 48 segments hain. Stage 5 mein kitne segments honge?
hints: What happens to the count at each new stage?
Use the same multiplier twice after stage 3.
Stage 5 count = 48 × ___ × ___.
768 segments; multiplying 48 by 4 twice gives the stage 5 count.

openers.prompt_en: On a school sports-field plan, a straight marking has a dot at A and a dot at B, with no arrows. Is the marking a point, line segment, line or ray?
openers.prompt_hi: School sports-field ke plan mein ek seedhi marking ke A aur B par dots hain, arrows nahin hain. Yeh point, line segment, line ya ray hai?
hints: What do the two dots tell you?
Check whether the drawing continues beyond either dot.
A straight part bounded at both ends is a ___.
Line segment: the dots mark its two endpoints.

openers.prompt_en: In a game-map diagram, a ray starts at P, passes through Q and has an arrow beyond Q. Is it named ray PQ or ray QP?
openers.prompt_hi: Game-map diagram mein ek ray P se shuru hokar Q se guzarti hai aur Q ke aage arrow hai. Iska naam ray PQ hai ya ray QP?
hints: Which labelled point is the starting point?
In a ray’s name, write its starting point first.
Starting letter ___, then the point it passes through.
Ray PQ: P is its starting point.

harder.prompt_en: On a metro map, a straight route is shown with arrows at both ends. Riya says the whole route has a fixed length because its drawing measures 8 cm. Why is that incorrect?
harder.prompt_hi: Metro map mein ek seedha route dono taraf arrows ke saath dikhaya hai. Riya kehti hai poore route ki fixed length hai kyunki drawing 8 cm hai. Yeh galat kyun hai?
harder.answer: The arrows show a line extending in both directions; 8 cm measures only the drawing.
acceptable: It has no endpoints; 8 cm is only the drawn part.
A line extends both ways, so its whole length cannot be measured.
hints: What do the arrows say about the route beyond the page?
Separate the mathematical figure from the ink used to show it.
The ruler measures the ___, not the whole figure.
The line extends both ways; 8 cm measures only its drawing.

verified.solverAnswer: A line with arrows at both ends extends infinitely, so it has no fixed length.

harder.prompt_en: On a number line, A is at 2 and B is at 5. A game token follows ray BA. Does it move towards increasing or decreasing numbers?
harder.prompt_hi: Number line par A, 2 par aur B, 5 par hai. Game token ray BA par chalta hai. Kya woh badhte hue ya ghatte hue numbers ki taraf jayega?
hints: At which letter does this ray begin?
Move from the first named point through the second.
From the starting number, travel through ___ and continue.
Decreasing numbers: ray BA starts at 5 and passes through 2.

harder.prompt_en: Five players stand at five marked points on a kabaddi-court diagram. Draw one line segment joining every pair of points. How many different segments are there?
harder.prompt_hi: Kabaddi court ke diagram mein paanch players paanch marked points par khade hain. Har pair ke points ko ek line segment se jodo. Kul kitne alag segments banenge?
hints: How many other points can each point join?
Counting from both ends repeats every segment.
Count all joins, then divide by ___.
10 segments: 5 × 4 counts each join twice.

openers.prompt_en: On a school map, two straight paths start at gate G and pass through library L and canteen C. Name the angle between the paths using three letters.
openers.prompt_hi: School map mein do seedhe raaste gate G se shuru hokar library L aur canteen C se guzarte hain. In raaston ke beech ka angle teen letters mein kaise likhoge?
hints: Where do the two paths meet?
In a three-letter angle name, the meeting point goes in the middle.
Write the name as L–___–C.
∠LGC; both paths start at G.

openers.prompt_en: Two laser beams leave point O, one passing through A and the other through B. Is the angle between them ∠AOB or ∠OAB?
openers.prompt_hi: Do laser beams point O se nikalti hain: ek A se aur doosri B se guzarti hai. Unke beech ka angle ∠AOB hai ya ∠OAB?
hints: Which point do both beams share?
The shared starting point must be the middle letter.
Choose the name with ___ in the middle.
∠AOB; O is where both beams start.

harder.prompt_en: At metro junction M, tracks go towards stations P, Q and R. Which names show the same angle: ∠PMQ, ∠QMP or ∠PMR?
harder.prompt_hi: Metro junction M se tracks stations P, Q aur R ki taraf jaate hain. Kaunse names ek hi angle dikhate hain: ∠PMQ, ∠QMP ya ∠PMR?
hints: Which two tracks form each named angle?
Reversing the outer letters keeps the same pair of arms.
The matching pair uses tracks towards ___ and ___.
∠PMQ and ∠QMP; both use the tracks towards P and Q.

harder.prompt_en: A phone's direction arrow starts pointing north. In Game A it turns clockwise to east; in Game B it turns clockwise to south. Which game has the greater angle of turn?
harder.prompt_hi: Phone ka direction arrow pehle north dikhata hai. Game A mein clockwise ghoomkar east, aur Game B mein clockwise ghoomkar south dikhata hai. Kis game mein turn ka angle zyada hai?
hints: How far does the arrow rotate in each game?
Compare the amount turned from the starting direction.
The arrow turns farther in Game ___.
Game B; reaching south takes more turning than reaching east.

harder.prompt_en: A designer places two angles on top of each other, matching their vertices and one arm. Their other arms overlap, but one drawing has longer arms. Are the angles equal? Why?
harder.prompt_hi: Designer do angles ko ek-doosre par rakhta hai; unke vertices aur ek-ek arm milte hain. Doosre arms bhi ek hi direction mein hain, par ek drawing ke arms lambe hain. Kya angles barabar hain? Kyun?
harder.answer: Yes; the amount of turn is the same, regardless of arm length.
acceptable: Equal; arm length does not change the angle
Haan, dono ka turn barabar hai
hints: What happens to the second arms when the first arms match?
Compare the opening, not how far the arms extend.
They are ___ because the amount of turn is ___.
Yes; overlapping arms show the same turn, regardless of length.

verified.solverAnswer: Yes, the angles are equal. Angle size depends on the amount of turn, not the length of the arms.

openers.prompt_en: On a school poster, an angle has vertex P and an arm PQ. Riya has lined up the protractor’s baseline with PQ, but its centre is on Q. To measure the angle, should she move the centre to P or leave it on Q?
openers.prompt_hi: School poster par angle ka vertex P hai aur ek arm PQ hai. Riya ne protractor ki baseline PQ se milayi hai, par centre Q par hai. Angle naapne ke liye centre P par laaye ya Q par rehne de?
hints: Which point is the angle’s vertex?
The protractor’s centre must match that point.
Move the centre from Q to ___.
Move it to P, because P is the vertex.

openers.prompt_en: To measure a corner of a badminton court diagram, the protractor’s centre is on the vertex and its baseline follows an arm pointing left. Which scale should you read: the one starting at 0 on the left or on the right?
openers.prompt_hi: Badminton court ke diagram ka corner naapne ke liye protractor ka centre vertex par hai aur baseline left ki taraf jaane wali arm par hai. Kaunsi scale padho: left par 0 se shuru hone wali ya right par 0 se?
openers.answer: The scale starting at 0 on the left
hints: Which way does the arm on the baseline point?
Begin reading at the zero beside that arm.
Read the scale whose zero is on the ___.
Use the left-starting scale; its zero lies on the arm.

verified.solverAnswer: The scale starting at 0 on the left

harder.prompt_en: A metro-map angle has its vertex at M. Arjun lines up the protractor’s baseline with one arm, but its centre is 1 cm from M. Why is his measurement unreliable?
harder.prompt_hi: Metro map ke angle ka vertex M hai. Arjun protractor ki baseline ek arm se milata hai, par centre M se 1 cm door hai. Uska measurement bharosemand kyun nahi hai?
harder.answer: The protractor’s centre is not on the vertex
hints: What must line up besides the baseline?
Check where the protractor’s centre sits.
The centre should coincide with ___.
The centre is not on vertex M, so the reading is unreliable.

verified.solverAnswer: Centre must be on vertex to measure correctly

harder.prompt_en: On a cricket-field diagram, one arm of an angle points right along the protractor’s baseline. The other arm crosses 125° on the right-starting scale and 55° on the left-starting scale. What is the angle?
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket-field diagram mein angle ki ek arm protractor ki baseline par right ki taraf hai. Doosri arm right se shuru hone wali scale par 125° aur left wali par 55° kaatati hai. Angle kitna hai?
hints: Where is zero for the arm pointing right?
Read the scale beginning beside that arm.
On that scale, the crossing is at ___°.
It is 125°; the right-pointing arm starts at that scale’s zero.

harder.prompt_en: For a school-stage plan, draw a 110° angle from an arm pointing left. The protractor’s centre is on the vertex and its baseline follows that arm. Which mark should you use: 110° on the left-starting scale or 110° on the right-starting scale?
harder.prompt_hi: School-stage plan mein left ki taraf jaane wali arm se 110° ka angle banao. Protractor ka centre vertex par hai aur baseline us arm par hai. Kaunsa mark loge: left se shuru hone wali scale par 110° ya right wali par 110°?
hints: Which end of the baseline does your first arm follow?
Choose the scale beginning at that end.
Mark 110° on the ___-starting scale.
Use 110° on the left-starting scale; its zero aligns with the arm.

openers.prompt_en: A cricket bat turns 65° from its starting position. Is the angle of the turn acute, right or obtuse?
openers.prompt_hi: Cricket bat apni shuru ki position se 65° ghoomta hai. Yeh turn ka angle acute, right ya obtuse hai?
hints: Is the turn smaller or larger than a square corner?
Compare its measure with a right angle.
Since 65° is less than ___°, its type is ___.
Acute: 65° is less than a right angle.

openers.prompt_en: In a phone game, an arrow rotates 210° clockwise from where it started. Is this turn a straight or reflex angle?
openers.prompt_hi: Phone game mein ek arrow apni shuru ki position se 210° clockwise ghoomta hai. Yeh straight angle hai ya reflex angle?
hints: Has the arrow turned more than halfway around?
Compare the turn with a straight angle.
A turn greater than ___° but less than a full turn is ___.
Reflex angle: 210° is greater than a straight angle.

harder.prompt_en: A school poster shows an 80° angle. A student widens it by 25°. Is the new angle acute, right or obtuse?
harder.prompt_hi: School poster par 80° ka angle hai. Ek student use 25° aur bada karta hai. Naya angle acute, right ya obtuse hai?
hints: What is the measure after widening?
Add the measures, then compare with a right angle.
80° + 25° = ___°; that lies between ___° and ___°.
Obtuse: the new angle is 105°, between 90° and 180°.

harder.prompt_en: A metro map marks 135° between two routes at an interchange. What is the angle around the other side of the point, and is it straight or reflex?
harder.prompt_hi: Metro map mein interchange par do routes ke beech 135° dikhaya hai. Point ke doosri taraf ka angle kitna hai, aur straight hai ya reflex?
hints: How much angle is there around one point altogether?
Subtract the marked angle from a full turn.
The other angle is ___° − 135° = ___°.
225°, reflex: 360° − 135° = 225°, more than a straight angle.

harder.prompt_en: At exactly 8:00, the minute hand points to 12 and the hour hand to 8. What type of angle is the smaller angle between the hands: acute, right or obtuse?
harder.prompt_hi: Bilkul 8:00 baje minute hand 12 par aur hour hand 8 par hai. Dono ke beech chhota angle acute, right ya obtuse hai?
hints: How many hour-mark gaps lie along the shorter path?
Each gap is one-twelfth of a full turn.
Shorter angle = ___ gaps × ___° per gap.
Obtuse: four gaps make 120°, between 90° and 180°.

openers.prompt_en: Five model towers stand in a row, with heights 12, 18, 15, 11 and 16 cm. Each tower gets a score equal to the number of towers immediately beside it that are taller. What score does the 15 cm tower get?
openers.prompt_hi: Paanch model towers ek line mein hain. Unki heights 12, 18, 15, 11 aur 16 cm hain. Har tower ka score hai: uske bilkul bagal mein kitne towers usse lambe hain. 15 cm wale tower ka score kya hoga?
hints: Which towers are immediately beside the 15 cm tower?
Compare only those two heights with 15 cm.
Of its two neighbours, ___ is taller.
1: only the 18 cm tower beside it is taller.

openers.prompt_en: A chart shows five days of phone data use, in order: 2, 5, 3, 4, 1 GB. A day is a supercell if its use exceeds every immediately neighbouring day. Which days are supercells?
openers.prompt_hi: Phone data use ka chart paanch din ke liye, kram se, 2, 5, 3, 4, 1 GB dikhata hai. Koi din supercell hai agar uska use bilkul bagal ke har din se zyada ho. Kaunse din supercells hain?
hints: Which days have data use greater than both adjacent days?
Check each day against its immediate neighbours, not the whole week.
The qualifying days are ___ and ___.
Days 2 and 4: each exceeds both of its neighbours.

harder.prompt_en: Six players line up by height: 146, 158, 151, 160, 154, 149 cm. Each says how many players immediately beside them are taller. What numbers do they say, from left to right?
harder.prompt_hi: Chhe players ki line mein heights 146, 158, 151, 160, 154, 149 cm hain. Har player batata hai ki uske bilkul bagal wale kitne players usse lambe hain. Left se right tak ve kaunse numbers bolenge?
acceptable: one, zero, two, zero, one, one
ek, shunya, do, shunya, ek, ek
hints: How many immediate neighbours does an end player have?
Compare each height only with heights directly beside it.
Write the six counts from left to right: ___, ___, ___, ___, ___, ___.
1, 0, 2, 0, 1, 1: each count uses immediate neighbours only.

harder.prompt_en: Metro passenger counts at five consecutive stations are 82, 67, 91, 74, 88. A count is a supercell if it exceeds every immediately neighbouring count; end counts have one neighbour. Is 91 the only supercell? Answer yes or no.
harder.prompt_hi: Paanch lagataar metro stations par passenger counts 82, 67, 91, 74, 88 hain. Supercell apne bilkul bagal ke har count se bada hota hai; end par sirf ek neighbour hota hai. Kya 91 hi akela supercell hai? Haan ya nahin?
hints: Have you checked the counts at both ends?
An end count needs comparison with only one neighbour.
The claim fails if another count exceeds its ___ neighbour.
No: 82 and 88 each exceed their sole neighbour too.

harder.prompt_en: A game asks you to arrange 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 in a row so that exactly four positions are supercells. A supercell exceeds every immediately neighbouring number. Is this possible? Say why in a short phrase.
harder.prompt_hi: Game mein 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ko line mein aise lagana hai ki theek chaar positions supercells hon. Supercell apne bilkul bagal ke har number se bada hota hai. Kya yeh mumkin hai? Chhote se reason ke saath batao.
harder.answer: No; adjacent positions cannot both be supercells.
acceptable: impossible; neighbouring positions cannot both be supercells
nahin, bagal ki dono positions supercells nahi ho sakti
hints: What happens if two neighbouring positions both claim to be supercells?
Compare those two numbers with each other.
For both to qualify, each would have to be ___ than the other.
No: adjacent positions cannot both be supercells, so four are impossible.

verified.solverAnswer: No, supercells can only occur at odd positions due to alternating high-low pattern.

ongrade.prompt_en: Seven kabaddi players stand in a line, with heights 148, 155, 151, 151, 162, 158 and 160 cm. Each says how many players standing immediately beside them are taller. What numbers do they say, from left to right?
ongrade.prompt_hi: Saat kabaddi players line mein khade hain. Unki heights 148, 155, 151, 151, 162, 158 aur 160 cm hain. Har player bolta hai ki bilkul bagal mein khade kitne players usse lambe hain. Left se right unke numbers kya honge?
acceptable: one, zero, one, one, zero, two, zero
ek, shunya, ek, ek, shunya, do, shunya
hints: Which players have only one neighbour?
Compare each height only with the heights immediately beside it.
For 158 cm, count taller neighbours: ___. Then finish the row.
1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 2, 0: equal heights do not count as taller.

ongrade.prompt_en: A school records attendance over seven days: 186, 204, 204, 197, 215, 209, 212. A supercell is greater than every number immediately beside it; end numbers have one neighbour. Which days are supercells?
ongrade.prompt_hi: School ki saat din ki attendance hai: 186, 204, 204, 197, 215, 209, 212. Supercell apne bilkul bagal ke har number se bada hota hai; end wale number ka ek neighbour hota hai. Kaunse din supercells hain?
hints: Do equal neighbouring numbers qualify?
Check each day against its immediate neighbours, not the whole row.
The days greater than every immediate neighbour are ___ and ___.
Days 5 and 7: each exceeds every immediate neighbour.

ongrade.prompt_en: A game uses six different numbers in one row. A supercell is greater than every immediate neighbour; an end number has one neighbour. Can you arrange the numbers so that four positions are supercells? Answer yes or no, with a reason.
ongrade.prompt_hi: Ek game mein chhe alag numbers ek row mein rakhne hain. Supercell apne har bilkul bagal wale number se bada hota hai; end number ka ek neighbour hota hai. Kya chaar positions supercells ban sakti hain? Haan ya nahin, wajah ke saath batao.
ongrade.answer: No; adjacent positions cannot both be supercells, so six positions can have at most three.
acceptable: No, at most three supercells are possible
Nahin, bagal wali dono positions supercells nahi ho sakti; zyada se zyada teen honge
No; two neighbours cannot both be greater than each other
hints: Can two positions beside each other both qualify?
Think about how many non-adjacent positions fit in the row.
The greatest possible number of supercells is ___.
No: adjacent positions cannot both qualify, so at most three can.

verified.solverAnswer: No, because at most two supercells possible in six numbers.

openers.prompt_en: A school event needs a 4-digit entry code with digit sum 17. Which code works: 8432, 7324, or 9205?
openers.prompt_hi: School event ke liye 4-digit entry code chahiye jiska digit sum 17 ho. Kaunsa code sahi hai: 8432, 7324, ya 9205?
hints: Which digits will you add for each code?
Digit sum means adding the digits, not reading the whole number.
For the first code, add 8 + 4 + 3 + 2 = ___.
8432; its digits add up to 17.

openers.prompt_en: For a metro ticket number, reverse 57 and add it to 57. What number do you get?
openers.prompt_hi: Metro ticket number 57 ko ulta likhkar 57 mein jodo. Kaunsa number milega?
hints: What happens to the tens and ones digits when you reverse it?
Write the reversed number below the original before adding.
The addition is 57 + ___; now calculate the total.
132; reversing 57 gives 75, and 57 + 75 = 132.

harder.prompt_en: A game awards a bonus for the greatest 4-digit number whose digit sum is 20. What number earns the bonus?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek game mein digit sum 20 wale sabse bade 4-digit number ko bonus milta hai. Kaunsa number bonus jeetega?
hints: How can you make the leftmost digit as large as possible?
To maximise a number, give earlier places the largest digits first.
Fill digits from left to right: 9, ___, ___, ___.
9920; putting the largest possible digits first makes it greatest.

harder.prompt_en: Start with 59. Keep reversing the number and adding it to the original until you get a palindrome. What is the first palindrome you reach?
harder.prompt_hi: 59 se shuru karo. Number ko ulta likhkar usi mein jodte raho, jab tak palindrome na mile. Pehla palindrome kya milega?
hints: After each addition, does the result read the same backwards?
If it does not, reverse the new result and add again.
Begin with 59 + 95 = ___; repeat the check.
1111; repeating reverse-and-add gives 154, then 605, then 1111.

harder.prompt_en: Run two rounds of the 4-digit Kaprekar routine starting at 4203: arrange its digits largest-to-smallest and smallest-to-largest, then subtract. Repeat with the result. Keep a zero at the front when needed. What is the second result?
harder.prompt_hi: 4203 se 4-digit Kaprekar routine ke do rounds karo: digits ko bade-se-chhote aur chhote-se-bade order mein likhkar ghatao. Phir result par yahi karo. Zaroorat ho toh shuru mein zero rakho. Doosra result kya hai?
hints: Which two arrangements can you make from the starting digits?
Keep the leading zero in the smaller arrangement; repeat after subtracting.
First subtraction: 4320 − 0234 = ___; arrange those digits again.
8172; the rounds give 4086, then 8640 − 0468 = 8172.

openers.prompt_en: A number game starts with 14 points. Its Collatz rule is: halve an even number; multiply an odd number by 3 and add 1. What are the next two numbers?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek number game 14 points se shuru hota hai. Collatz rule hai: even number ko aadha karo; odd number ko 3 se multiply karke 1 jodo. Agle do numbers kya hain?
hints: Is the starting number even or odd?
Apply the rule again to the number you get first.
7, 22: halve 14, then calculate 3 × 7 + 1.

openers.prompt_en: A metro display plays the Collatz game starting at 8. It halves even numbers and uses 3n + 1 for odd numbers. How many steps does it take to first reach 1? Count each change as one step.
openers.prompt_hi: Metro display 8 se Collatz game shuru karta hai. Even number aadha hota hai aur odd number par 3n + 1 lagta hai. Pehli baar 1 tak pahunchne mein kitne steps lagenge? Har change ek step hai.
hints: What rule applies to the starting number?
Keep applying the rule; count arrows, not numbers.
3 steps: the sequence is 8 → 4 → 2 → 1.

harder.prompt_en: A cricket scoreboard applies the Collatz rule to 19: halve if even; use 3n + 1 if odd. What number appears after three changes?
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket scoreboard 19 par Collatz rule lagata hai: even ho to aadha, odd ho to 3n + 1. Teen changes ke baad kaunsa number dikhega?
hints: Which rule applies to the starting number?
Check odd or even again after every change.
88: the three changes give 19 → 58 → 29 → 88.

harder.prompt_en: Two game scores start at 10 and 16. Apply the Collatz rule until each first reaches 1: halve even numbers; use 3n + 1 for odd numbers. Which start takes more steps, and by how many?
harder.prompt_hi: Do game scores 10 aur 16 se shuru hote hain. Dono par Collatz rule 1 tak lagao: even ko aadha, odd par 3n + 1. Kaunsa start zyada steps leta hai, aur kitne zyada?
hints: How many arrows does each sequence need to reach 1?
Count a change as one step, including the final change.
Steps from 10 = ___; steps from 16 = ___; difference = ___.
10, by 2 steps: it needs 6 steps, while 16 needs 4.

harder.prompt_en: A computer checked the Collatz rule for a lakh starting numbers; each reached 1. Why is “every positive whole number reaches 1” still a conjecture: because the computer is slow, or because checking a lakh cases does not prove all cases?
harder.prompt_hi: Computer ne ek lakh starting numbers par Collatz rule check kiya; sab 1 tak pahunche. ‘Har positive whole number 1 tak pahunchega’ ab bhi conjecture kyun hai: computer slow hai, ya ek lakh cases check karna sabhi cases ka proof nahi hai?
harder.answer: Checking a lakh cases does not prove all cases
acceptable: a lakh cases do not prove every case
ek lakh cases check karna sabhi cases ka proof nahi hai
hints: How many positive whole numbers are there?
Compare the tested set with every possible starting number.
Testing many cases supports the claim, but does not ___ it.
Checking a lakh cases does not prove all cases: untested numbers remain.

verified.solverAnswer: Because checking a lakh cases does not prove all cases.

openers.prompt_en: A metro station recorded 3,746 passengers before noon. Round this number to the nearest hundred for a quick report.
openers.prompt_hi: Metro station par dopahar se pehle 3,746 passengers aaye. Jaldi report banane ke liye is sankhya ko nearest hundred tak round karo.
hints: Which digit decides whether the hundreds digit changes?
Look at the tens digit when rounding to hundreds.
The tens digit is below five, so the hundreds digit stays ___.
3,700 passengers; the tens digit, 4, does not raise the hundreds digit.

openers.prompt_en: At a school event, one tray holds about 22 juice cups. There are 15 similar trays. Estimate the total by using 20 cups per tray.
openers.prompt_hi: School event mein ek tray par lagbhag 22 juice cups hain. Aisi 15 trays hain. Har tray mein 20 cups maan kar total estimate karo.
hints: What does one tray tell you about the other trays?
Use the suggested cups-per-tray estimate for every tray.
Estimated total = number of trays × ___ cups.
About 300 cups; 15 trays with 20 cups each give that estimate.

harder.prompt_en: Two school teams collected ₹1,487 and ₹2,612. Round each amount to the nearest hundred, then estimate their combined collection.
harder.prompt_hi: Do school teams ne ₹1,487 aur ₹2,612 collect kiye. Dono amounts ko nearest hundred tak round karke total collection estimate karo.
acceptable: about four thousand one hundred rupees
lagbhag chaar hazaar ek sau rupaye
hints: Which place value will you use for each amount?
Round both amounts before adding them.
Rounded amounts: ₹___ + ₹___; now add.
About ₹4,100; ₹1,500 plus ₹2,600 gives the estimate.

harder.prompt_en: A school directory has 120 similar pages. You count about 45 names on one page. Estimate the total number of names using this sample.
harder.prompt_hi: School directory mein 120 milte-julte pages hain. Ek page par tumne lagbhag 45 names gine. Is sample se total names estimate karo.
acceptable: about five thousand four hundred names
lagbhag paanch hazaar chaar sau names
hints: How can one page help estimate all the pages?
Multiply the sample count by the total pages.
Estimated names = 45 × ___ pages.
About 5,400 names; 45 names across 120 similar pages gives the estimate.

harder.prompt_en: A cricket club buys 25 jerseys at ₹398 each. Find the exact total mentally by using ₹400 per jersey, then adjusting.
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket club 25 jerseys kharidta hai, har ek ₹398 ki. Pehle ₹400 per jersey lekar, phir adjust karke exact total mann mein nikalo.
acceptable: nine thousand nine hundred fifty rupees
nau hazaar nau sau pachaas rupaye
hints: How much extra would you count at ₹400 per jersey?
Find the total at ₹400 each, then subtract the extra.
Exact total = 25 × 400 − 25 × ___.
₹9,950; ₹10,000 minus ₹50 corrects the ₹2 extra per jersey.

openers.prompt_en: The school canteen must decide how many idlis and poha plates to prepare tomorrow. Which survey question gives useful counts: A, “Do you like breakfast?” or B, “Which will you buy tomorrow: idli, poha, or neither?”
openers.prompt_hi: School canteen ko kal ke liye idli aur poha ki plates ki sankhya tay karni hai. Kaunsa survey question useful counts dega: A, “Kya tumhe breakfast pasand hai?” ya B, “Kal kya kharidoge: idli, poha, ya kuchh nahi?”
hints: Which question separates the two dishes?
The canteen needs a count for each possible choice.
Choose the question whose answers can be counted by dish: ___.
B; its options give separate counts for idli and poha.

openers.prompt_en: At a school book exchange, students brought 5 comics, 3 atlases, 5 comics, 2 atlases, and 4 comics. What frequency should the tally table show for comics?
openers.prompt_hi: School book exchange mein students 5 comics, 3 atlases, 5 comics, 2 atlases aur 4 comics laaye. Tally table mein comics ki frequency kya hogi?
hints: Which entries belong in the comics row?
Add only the counts for that category.
Comics frequency = ___ + ___ + ___.
14 comics; add 5, 5, and 4.

harder.prompt_en: A school wants to count demand for a new metro-bus pass. Why is “Which pass would you buy: metro, bus, combined, or none?” better than “How do you travel?” Answer with the key data-handling reason.
harder.prompt_hi: School naye metro-bus pass ki demand ginna chahta hai. “Kaunsa pass kharidoge: metro, bus, combined, ya koi nahi?” sawaal “Tum kaise travel karte ho?” se behtar kyun hai? Data-handling ka mukhya kaaran batao.
harder.answer: It gives fixed pass choices that can be counted separately.
acceptable: Each pass option can be counted
It gives countable categories for each pass
Fixed options make a frequency table possible
hints: What exactly does the school need to count?
Compare answers about current travel with choices about future passes.
The better question lets the school count ___ for each pass.
It gives fixed pass choices that can be counted separately.

verified.solverAnswer: It gives exact counts of each option, not just travel method.

harder.prompt_en: For a gaming club survey, 23 students chose chess. A tally keeper has drawn three complete bundles of five. How many more tally strokes must be added to finish the chess row?
harder.prompt_hi: Gaming club survey mein 23 students ne chess chuna. Tally banane wale ne paanch-paanch ke teen poore bundles bana diye. Chess wali row poori karne ke liye aur kitne tally strokes jodne honge?
hints: How many students are already represented?
Find the difference between the frequency and the tallies drawn.
Strokes still needed = 23 − ___ = ___.
8 strokes; three bundles represent 15, leaving 8.

harder.prompt_en: Thirty-six students each chose one workshop. The frequency table shows coding 12, robotics 11, and photography 9. If these are the only options, how many responses are missing from the table?
harder.prompt_hi: 36 students ne ek-ek workshop chuni. Frequency table mein coding 12, robotics 11 aur photography 9 hain. Agar options sirf yehi hain, toh table se kitne responses missing hain?
hints: Does the table total match the number surveyed?
Add the three frequencies, then compare with the class total.
Missing responses = 36 − (___ + ___ + ___).
4 responses; the listed frequencies total 32, not 36.

ongrade.prompt_en: A school needs to estimate how many students will board its buses at each stop. Which survey question should it ask: A, “Which school-bus stop do you use?” or B, “Do you like travelling by bus?”
ongrade.prompt_hi: School ko estimate karna hai ki har stop par kitne students bus mein chadhenge. Kaunsa survey question poochna chahiye: A, “Tum kaunsa school-bus stop use karte ho?” ya B, “Kya tumhein bus se jaana pasand hai?”
acceptable: Which school-bus stop do you use?
hints: What must the school count separately?
Choose a question whose answers can be grouped by stop.
The useful question is option ___.
A. It lets the school count students at each stop.

ongrade.prompt_en: Students chose phone data packs for a trip: 1 GB, 2 GB, 1.5 GB, 1 GB, 1.5 GB, 2 GB, 1.5 GB, 1 GB, 2 GB, 1.5 GB, 1.5 GB, 2 GB. How many tally marks go in the 1.5 GB row?
ongrade.prompt_hi: Trip ke liye students ne phone data packs chune: 1 GB, 2 GB, 1.5 GB, 1 GB, 1.5 GB, 2 GB, 1.5 GB, 1 GB, 2 GB, 1.5 GB, 1.5 GB, 2 GB. 1.5 GB wali row mein kitne tally marks honge?
hints: Which entries belong in the specified row?
Scan the list and mark each matching entry once.
The frequency for that row is ___.
5 tally marks; the pack appears five times.

ongrade.prompt_en: In a survey of 40 students, each chose one school club. The frequency table shows music 9, coding 13, art unknown, and theatre 6. What frequency completes the art row so the table’s total matches the survey?
ongrade.prompt_hi: 40 students ke survey mein har student ne ek school club chuna. Frequency table mein music 9, coding 13, art unknown aur theatre 6 hai. Table ka total survey se match karne ke liye art ki frequency kya hogi?
hints: How many responses must the completed table show?
Add the known frequencies, then compare with the survey size.
Art frequency = total surveyed − known frequencies = ___.
12 students; the known frequencies total 28 out of 40.

openers.prompt_en: A pictograph of a school book fair uses the key 1 book symbol = 7 books sold. The comics row has 5 symbols. How many comics were sold?
openers.prompt_hi: School book fair ke pictograph mein key hai: 1 book symbol = 7 books sold. Comics ki row mein 5 symbols hain. Kitni comics biki?
hints: What does one symbol stand for here?
Use the key for every symbol in the row.
Number sold = symbols × books per symbol = ___
35 comics: five symbols each stand for seven books.

openers.prompt_en: In a pictograph of phone-data use, 1 circle = 4 GB. Meera's row has 2 full circles and 1 half-circle. How many GB did she use?
openers.prompt_hi: Phone-data pictograph mein 1 circle = 4 GB hai. Meera ki row mein 2 poore circles aur 1 half-circle hai. Usne kitna GB data use kiya?
hints: How much data does the half-circle represent?
Count the full circles, then add the half-circle's value.
Total data = (2 × 4) + ___ GB.
10 GB: two full circles show 8 GB, and half shows 2 GB.

harder.prompt_en: A metro pictograph shows trips made in a week. The key is 1 train symbol = 12 trips. Monday has 7 symbols and Tuesday has 4. How many more trips were made on Monday?
harder.prompt_hi: Metro trips ke pictograph mein 1 train symbol = 12 trips hai. Monday ko 7 symbols aur Tuesday ko 4 hain. Monday ko kitni zyada trips hui?
hints: How many extra symbols does Monday have?
Find the difference in symbols before using the key.
Extra trips = (7 − 4) × ___
36 trips: three extra symbols represent 12 trips each.

harder.prompt_en: For a school collection drive, 1 box symbol = 16 notebooks. Class 6A has 3 full symbols and a half; Class 6B has 2 full symbols and a half. How many notebooks did they collect altogether?
harder.prompt_hi: School collection drive mein 1 box symbol = 16 notebooks hai. Class 6A ke 3 poore symbols aur ek half hai; 6B ke 2 poore symbols aur ek half. Dono ne milakar kitni notebooks collect ki?
hints: What do the two half-symbols make together?
Combine both rows' symbols before applying the key.
Combined symbols = 3 + 2 + ___; then use the key.
96 notebooks: the rows combine to six symbols, each worth 16.

harder.prompt_en: A pictograph must show 18, 27 and 36 tickets sold at three school stalls, using only full symbols. Which key works: 1 symbol = 6 tickets or 1 symbol = 9 tickets?
harder.prompt_hi: Teen school stalls par 18, 27 aur 36 tickets biki. Pictograph mein sirf poore symbols use karne hain. Kaunsi key kaam karegi: 1 symbol = 6 tickets ya 1 symbol = 9 tickets?
hints: Which key gives whole symbols for every stall?
Check whether each ticket count divides exactly by the key.
For the working key: 18 ÷ ___, 27 ÷ ___, 36 ÷ ___.
9 tickets: it divides all three counts; 6 does not divide 27.

openers.prompt_en: A bar graph shows kilometres cycled. Each square represents 4 km. Riya’s bar reaches halfway through its third square. How far did she cycle?
openers.prompt_hi: Cycling ke bar graph mein har square 4 km dikhata hai. Riya ka bar teesre square ke beech tak pahunchta hai. Usne kitni doori cycle chalayi?
hints: How many complete squares does the bar cover?
Count complete squares, then add half a square.
Distance = (2 + ½) × ___ km.
10 km: two full squares give 8 km, and half gives 2 km.

openers.prompt_en: A school wants to graph up to 72 library books using at most 9 squares of height. Which scale fits: 1 square = 6 books or 1 square = 8 books?
openers.prompt_hi: School ko 72 tak library books ka bar graph banana hai, aur height ke liye zyada se zyada 9 squares hain. Kaunsa scale fit hoga: 1 square = 6 books ya 1 square = 8 books?
hints: How tall would the largest bar be with each scale?
Divide the largest value by books per square.
For one option, the required height is 72 ÷ ___ squares.
1 square = 8 books: 72 books take exactly 9 squares.

harder.prompt_en: On a bar graph of quiz points, the axis is marked 0, 12, 24, 36. Aarav’s bar ends halfway between the 24 and 36 marks. How many points did he score?
harder.prompt_hi: Quiz points ke bar graph ka axis 0, 12, 24, 36 par marked hai. Aarav ka bar 24 aur 36 ke bilkul beech mein khatam hota hai. Uske kitne points hain?
hints: What is the gap between the two nearby marks?
Halfway means adding half that gap to the lower mark.
30 points: halfway from 24 to 36 adds 6.

harder.prompt_en: At a school fest, 120 people chose music and 75 chose dance. Using 1 square = 15 people, how tall should the music and dance bars be, in that order?
harder.prompt_hi: School fest mein 120 logon ne music aur 75 ne dance chuna. Agar 1 square = 15 log hain, toh music aur dance ke bars ki height isi order mein kitne squares hogi?
hints: How do you convert each count into squares?
Divide each count by the number of people per square.
Bar heights = 120 ÷ ___ and 75 ÷ ___ squares.
8 and 5 squares: divide each count by 15.

harder.prompt_en: A phone battery graph starts its axis at 70%. One bar reaches 80% and another reaches 90%. Their visible heights are 10 and 20 units. Why is saying the second battery has twice the charge misleading?
harder.prompt_hi: Phone battery graph ka axis 70% se shuru hota hai. Ek bar 80% aur doosra 90% tak pahunchta hai. Dikhne wali heights 10 aur 20 units hain. Doosri battery mein double charge kehna misleading kyun hai?
harder.answer: The axis starts at 70%, not zero; 90% is not twice 80%.
acceptable: The axis is cut off at 70%
The graph omits 0%, making the difference look bigger
hints: Where does the graph’s vertical axis begin?
Compare the actual percentages, not just the visible bar heights.
The claim is misleading because the axis omits ___%.
It starts at 70%, not zero; 90% is not twice 80%.

verified.solverAnswer: The axis does not start at 0%, exaggerating the difference.

openers.prompt_en: A school has 18 badminton rackets. It wants to arrange all of them in equal rows, with none left over. What are all the possible numbers of rackets in one row?
openers.prompt_hi: School mein 18 badminton rackets hain. Sabko barabar rows mein rakhna hai, koi bachna nahi chahiye. Ek row mein rackets ki kaun-kaun si sankhya ho sakti hai?
acceptable: one, two, three, six, nine, eighteen
ek, do, teen, chhe, nau, atharah
hints: Which row sizes leave no rackets over?
A possible row size must be a factor of the total.
Find factor pairs first: ___ × ___.
1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 18; each divides 18 exactly.

openers.prompt_en: A school science club posts an update every 9 days. If today is day 0, on which of the first 50 days will it post an update?
openers.prompt_hi: School science club har 9 din mein update post karta hai. Agar aaj day 0 hai, toh pehle 50 dinon mein kin day numbers par update post hoga?
hints: What pattern do the update days follow?
List multiples of the posting interval up to the limit.
The update days are interval × ___, stopping before the limit.
Days 9, 18, 27, 36, 45; these are multiples of 9 below 50.

harder.prompt_en: A coach has 36 players and wants equal-sized teams with no player left out. Which team sizes are greater than 4 but less than 20? List all possibilities.
harder.prompt_hi: Coach ke paas 36 players hain. Bina kisi ko chhode barabar size ki teams banani hain. Team size 4 se bada aur 20 se chhota ho. Saare possible sizes batao.
hints: Which team sizes divide the player count exactly?
Find factor pairs, then check the size limits.
Keep only factors greater than ___ and less than ___.
6, 9, 12, 18; each divides 36 and fits the limits.

harder.prompt_en: A school has 48 cricket balls and 60 tennis balls. It wants the greatest possible number of identical kits, using every ball. How many kits can it make?
harder.prompt_hi: School ke paas 48 cricket balls aur 60 tennis balls hain. Saari balls use karke sabse zyada ek-jaisi kits banani hain. Kitni kits banengi?
hints: What must the number of kits divide exactly?
Look for a common factor of both ball counts.
The greatest shared factor is ___; that is the kit count.
12 kits; 12 is the greatest factor shared by 48 and 60.

harder.prompt_en: Two phone apps back up every 12 days and every 18 days. Both backed up today. After how many days will they next back up on the same day?
harder.prompt_hi: Do phone apps har 12 din aur har 18 din mein backup leti hain. Dono ne aaj backup liya. Ab kitne din baad dono ka backup phir ek hi din hoga?
hints: Which future days appear in both backup schedules?
List multiples of each interval and find their first match.
The first shared multiple is ___ days.
36 days; it is the first multiple shared by 12 and 18.

openers.prompt_en: A school club has 39 badges. Is 39 prime or composite? Give one factor pair to support your answer.
openers.prompt_hi: School club ke paas 39 badges hain. 39 prime hai ya composite? Apna answer support karne ke liye ek factor pair batao.
hints: Can the badges be split into equal groups?
Check for a factor besides 1 and the number itself.
Composite: 39 = 3 × 13, giving it more than two factors.

openers.prompt_en: On a number chart, cross out multiples of 2, 3 and 5. Which numbers from 30 to 40 remain as primes?
openers.prompt_hi: Number chart mein 2, 3 aur 5 ke multiples kaato. 30 se 40 tak kaun se numbers prime bachenge?
hints: Which numbers can you cross out immediately?
Among those left, check the given multiplication tables.
After crossing out their multiples, the remaining numbers are ___.
31 and 37 remain; neither is a multiple of 2, 3 or 5.

harder.prompt_en: A game gives a bonus if your score is prime. Meera scores 97. Checking possible factors up to 9, does she get the bonus? Answer yes or no.
harder.prompt_hi: Game mein score prime hone par bonus milta hai. Meera ka score 97 hai. 9 tak possible factors check karke batao: bonus milega, haan ya nahin?
hints: Which small prime numbers should Meera test?
A composite number here would have a factor no greater than 9.
Test the small primes up to 9; the bonus decision is ___.
Yes. None of the primes up to 9 divides 97.

harder.prompt_en: In a sieve from 1 to 100, cross out multiples of 2, 3, 5 and 7, keeping those four primes. Which primes remain between 80 and 100?
harder.prompt_hi: 1 se 100 ki sieve mein 2, 3, 5 aur 7 ke multiples kaato, lekin in chaar primes ko rakho. 80 aur 100 ke beech kaun se primes bachenge?
hints: Which numbers in this range survive crossing out even numbers?
Now eliminate multiples from the other three tables.
After all four tables are checked, the survivors are ___.
83, 89 and 97 survive; none has a factor among 2, 3, 5, 7.

harder.prompt_en: A classmate says, “If 2 is prime, some bigger even numbers might be prime too.” Why is 2 the only even prime?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek classmate kehta hai, ‘Agar 2 prime hai, toh kuch bade even numbers bhi prime ho sakte hain.’ 2 hi eklauta even prime kyun hai?
harder.answer: Every even number greater than 2 has 2 as a factor besides 1 and itself.
acceptable: Bade even numbers 2 se divide hote hain, isliye unke do se zyada factors hote hain
Every bigger even number is divisible by 2 and is composite
hints: What do all even numbers have in common?
Compare the factors of 2 with those of a larger even number.
For a larger even number, ___ is an extra factor.
Every larger even number has 2 as an extra factor, so it is composite.

verified.solverAnswer: All other even numbers have 2 as a factor.

openers.prompt_en: A school club has 10 red badges and 13 blue badges. Are 10 and 13 co-prime?
openers.prompt_hi: School club ke paas 10 red badges aur 13 blue badges hain. Kya 10 aur 13 co-prime hain?
hints: Which factors appear in both factor lists?
Co-prime numbers have no common factor other than 1.
The common factors are ___; so the numbers are ___.
Yes; their only common factor is 1.

openers.prompt_en: A game shows scores of 14 and 21. Are these two scores co-prime?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek game mein scores 14 aur 21 hain. Kya ye dono scores co-prime hain?
acceptable: no, they have a common factor besides 1
hints: Can you find a factor shared by both scores?
Check factors besides 1 before deciding.
Both numbers are divisible by ___; so they are ___.
No; both are divisible by 7.

harder.prompt_en: A school event uses 35 chairs in one section and 48 in another. Are 35 and 48 co-prime? Check their common factors.
harder.prompt_hi: School event mein ek section mein 35 chairs aur doosre mein 48 hain. Kya 35 aur 48 co-prime hain? Common factors check karo.
acceptable: yes, their only common factor is 1
hints: What factors does each number have?
Compare the two factor lists, not just the numbers themselves.
Their only common factor is ___; therefore ___.
Yes; their only common factor is 1.

verified.solverAnswer: yes, their only common factor is 1

harder.prompt_en: A quiz claims, ‘If neither number is prime, they cannot be co-prime.’ Do 16 and 25 prove this claim right or wrong? Answer ‘right’ or ‘wrong’.
harder.prompt_hi: Quiz ka claim hai, ‘Agar dono numbers prime nahi hain, toh woh co-prime nahi ho sakte.’ Kya 16 aur 25 is claim ko right ya wrong saabit karte hain? ‘Right’ ya ‘wrong’ bolo.
hints: What factors do these numbers share?
A number need not be prime to belong to a co-prime pair.
Their only common factor is ___; the claim is ___.
Wrong; 16 and 25 share only 1.

harder.prompt_en: A metro app assigns consecutive trip numbers 1,24,568 and 1,24,569. Why must these numbers be co-prime?
harder.prompt_hi: Metro app ne lagataar trips ko numbers 1,24,568 aur 1,24,569 diye hain. Ye numbers co-prime kyun honge?
harder.answer: Any common factor must divide their difference, 1.
acceptable: their difference is 1, so they share no factor greater than 1
consecutive numbers have only 1 as a common factor
hints: What is the difference between the trip numbers?
A common factor must also divide their difference.
Their difference is ___; any common factor must divide it.
Any common factor divides their difference, 1; therefore only 1 is common.

verified.solverAnswer: Consecutive numbers differ by 1 so share no common factor > 1.

openers.prompt_en: A school orders 42 badges. Start a factor tree with 42 = 6 × 7. What two factors should replace 6?
openers.prompt_hi: School ne 42 badges mangaye hain. Factor tree mein 42 = 6 × 7 se shuru karo. 6 ki jagah kaun se do factors likhoge?
hints: Which two numbers multiply to make 6?
Choose factors that cannot be split further into smaller factors above 1.
Replace 6 with ___ × ___.
2 and 3; both are prime, and their product is 6.

openers.prompt_en: A game gives 28 points. A factor tree starts 28 = 4 × 7. Write 28 as a product of primes.
openers.prompt_hi: Ek game mein 28 points mile. Factor tree 28 = 4 × 7 se shuru hota hai. 28 ko primes ke product ke roop mein likho.
hints: Can every number at the end of this tree stay there?
Split any factor that is not prime.
2 × 2 × 7; splitting 4 leaves only prime factors.

harder.prompt_en: For 126 seats at a school event, start a factor tree with 126 = 9 × 14. What factor pair replaces 9, and what factor pair replaces 14?
harder.prompt_hi: School event mein 126 seats hain. Factor tree 126 = 9 × 14 se shuru karo. 9 ki jagah kaun sa factor pair aur 14 ki jagah kaun sa pair aayega?
hints: Which two branches still need splitting?
Find a multiplication pair for each branch separately.
9 → 3 × 3; 14 → 2 × 7; each pair multiplies to its branch.

harder.prompt_en: A cricket score of 90 is written as 2 × 3 × 15. Is this a complete prime factorisation? Answer yes or no, and give the corrected product.
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket score 90 ko 2 × 3 × 15 likha hai. Kya yeh complete prime factorisation hai? Haan ya nahin bolo, aur sahi product batao.
hints: Is every factor in the written product prime?
A composite factor must be split before the tree is complete.
Replace the composite factor: 90 = 2 × 3 × ___ × ___.
No; 2 × 3 × 3 × 5, because 15 is composite.

harder.prompt_en: A school club has 84 stickers and 55 bookmarks. To make identical packs with none left over, can it make more than one pack? Use prime factors to answer yes or no.
harder.prompt_hi: School club ke paas 84 stickers aur 55 bookmarks hain. Bina kuch bachaaye ek jaise packs banane hain. Kya ek se zyada packs ban sakte hain? Prime factors se haan ya nahin batao.
harder.answer: No; 84 and 55 have no common prime factor
acceptable: Nahin, koi common prime factor nahin hai
hints: What must the number of packs divide?
Compare the prime factors of both totals.
No; the totals share no prime factor, so no pack count above 1 divides both.

openers.prompt_en: A game gives 765 coins. Can they be shared equally among 2 players or among 5 players, with none left over? Choose: 2 only, 5 only, both, or neither.
openers.prompt_hi: Ek game mein 765 coins mile. Kya inhe 2 players ya 5 players mein barabar baant sakte hain, bina kuch bache? Chuno: sirf 2, sirf 5, dono, ya koi nahi.
hints: Which part of 765 helps you check both group sizes?
Use the last-digit tests rather than dividing the whole number.
The last digit is ___; apply each test separately.
5 only: 765 ends in 5, so it passes the test for 5, not 2.

openers.prompt_en: A school orders 1,324 badges and packs them in sets of 4. Will any badges be left over? Answer yes or no.
openers.prompt_hi: School ne 1,324 badges mangaye aur unhe 4 ke sets mein pack kiya. Kya koi badge bachega? Haan ya nahi?
hints: Do you need to divide all 1,324 badges?
For sets of 4, focus on the final two digits.
The final two digits are ___; check if they divide by 4.
No: 24 divides by 4, so 1,324 badges make complete sets.

harder.prompt_en: A shopkeeper says a bill amount can be divisible by both 2 and 5 but not by 10. Why is that impossible?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek shopkeeper kehta hai ki bill ki rakam 2 aur 5 dono se divide ho sakti hai, lekin 10 se nahi. Yeh impossible kyun hai?
harder.answer: A number divisible by both 2 and 5 must end in 0, so it is divisible by 10.
acceptable: It must end in zero, so 10 divides it
Dono se divide hone ke liye aakhri digit 0 hogi, isliye 10 se bhi divide hoga
hints: What last digit could pass both tests?
Compare the allowed last digits for 2 and for 5.
The common allowed last digit is ___; then check 10.
It must end in 0, which also makes it divisible by 10.

verified.solverAnswer: Divisible by 2 and 5 means divisible by 10.

harder.prompt_en: A metro card number is 83,416. Why are its last three digits enough to decide whether 8 divides the whole number?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek metro card ka number 83,416 hai. Pura number 8 se divide hota hai ya nahi, yeh jaanne ke liye aakhri teen digits hi kaafi kyun hain?
harder.answer: The part before the last three digits represents a multiple of 1,000, and 1,000 is divisible by 8.
acceptable: Pehle wala hissa 1,000 ka multiple hai, aur 1,000 ko 8 divide karta hai
hints: What place value starts immediately before the final three digits?
Separate the number into thousands and a remainder below 1,000.
The earlier part is a multiple of ___; test that place value.
Thousands do not affect the test: 1,000 is divisible by 8.

verified.solverAnswer: 8 divides a number if it divides the last three digits.
verified.note: Solver gives divisibility rule, not why 1000 works

harder.prompt_en: A ticket code is 58,4_2. What digit replaces the blank so the code is divisible by 9?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek ticket code 58,4_2 hai. Blank mein kaunsa digit aayega taaki code 9 se divide ho?
hints: What can the digits tell you without dividing the full code?
Add the known digits, then consider the missing digit.
The known digits sum to ___; complete a multiple of 9.
8: the digit sum becomes 27, which is divisible by 9.

openers.prompt_en: A five-sided school-event banner has edge lengths 4 cm, 7 cm, 5 cm, 6 cm and 8 cm. How much ribbon is needed to go once around its edge?
openers.prompt_hi: School event ke paanch sides wale banner ki sides 4 cm, 7 cm, 5 cm, 6 cm aur 8 cm hain. Iske edge par ek baar ribbon lagane ke liye kitni ribbon chahiye?
hints: Which edges will the ribbon cover?
Perimeter is the total length around the banner.
Add every edge: 4 + 7 + 5 + 6 + 8 = ___ cm.
30 cm; that is the sum of all five edges.

openers.prompt_en: A phone screen protector is rectangular, 18 cm long and 8 cm wide. What is the distance around its edge?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek phone screen protector rectangle shape ka hai, 18 cm lamba aur 8 cm chauda. Iske edge ke chaaron taraf ki distance kitni hai?
hints: Which side lengths occur more than once?
A rectangle has two lengths and two breadths.
Distance around = 2 × (18 + 8) = ___ cm.
52 cm; count both lengths and both breadths.

harder.prompt_en: A six-sided display board for a science exhibition has consecutive edges of 12 cm, 7 cm, 9 cm, 5 cm, 8 cm and 11 cm. How much tape covers its edge once?
harder.prompt_hi: Science exhibition ke six-sided display board ki lagatar sides 12 cm, 7 cm, 9 cm, 5 cm, 8 cm aur 11 cm hain. Edge ko ek baar cover karne ke liye kitna tape chahiye?
hints: Does any edge get left out?
Tape around the boundary needs the sum of every edge.
52 cm; all six edges are included.

harder.prompt_en: A square rangoli has side 14 cm. A rectangular mat measures 18 cm by 10 cm. Which has the greater perimeter: the rangoli, the mat, or neither?
harder.prompt_hi: Square rangoli ki side 14 cm hai. Rectangular mat 18 cm by 10 cm hai. Kiska perimeter zyada hai: rangoli ka, mat ka, ya kisi ka bhi nahi?
harder.answer: Neither; both have the same perimeter.
hints: How would you find each distance around?
Use four equal sides for the square; pair opposite rectangle sides.
Neither; both perimeters are 56 cm.

harder.prompt_en: A rectangular kabaddi practice ground has a perimeter of 146 m and a length of 45 m. What is its breadth?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek rectangular kabaddi practice ground ka perimeter 146 m aur length 45 m hai. Iski breadth kitni hai?
hints: What does half the perimeter represent?
Half the perimeter is one length plus one breadth.
28 m; subtract the length from half the perimeter.

openers.prompt_en: A school logo drawn on a 1 cm square grid covers 8 full squares and 6 half squares. What is its area?
openers.prompt_hi: School ka logo 1 cm squares wali grid par bana hai. Yeh 8 poore squares aur 6 aadhe squares cover karta hai. Iska area kya hai?
hints: How could you combine the half squares?
Pair the halves to make full squares.
11 sq cm: six halves make three full squares.

openers.prompt_en: A rectangular practice mat for kabaddi is 8 m long and 5 m wide. What area does it cover?
openers.prompt_hi: Kabaddi practice ki rectangular mat 8 m lambi aur 5 m chaudi hai. Yeh kitna area cover karti hai?
hints: What calculation gives a rectangle’s area?
Multiply its length by its width.
40 sq m: length multiplied by width gives area.

harder.prompt_en: On a grid of 1 cm squares, a design for a school badge covers 13 full squares and 9 half squares. What is its area?
harder.prompt_hi: 1 cm squares wali grid par school badge ka design 13 poore squares aur 9 aadhe squares cover karta hai. Iska area kya hai?
hints: Can every half square be paired?
Pair as many halves as possible; one half remains.
17.5 sq cm: nine halves add four and a half squares.

harder.prompt_en: A 3 m by 2 m study-room floor needs square tiles measuring 50 cm on each side. With no gaps or cuts, how many tiles cover it?
harder.prompt_hi: Study room ka floor 3 m by 2 m hai. Har square tile ki side 50 cm hai. Bina gap ya cut ke, kitni tiles lagenगी?
hints: How many tile sides fit along each floor side?
Convert metres to centimetres, then count rows and columns.
24 tiles: six fit along one side and four along the other.

harder.prompt_en: Two rectangular school stalls each need 20 m of rope around them. Stall A measures 4 m by 6 m; Stall B measures 2 m by 8 m. Which stall has more floor area?
harder.prompt_hi: Do rectangular school stalls ke chaaron taraf 20 m rope lagti hai. Stall A 4 m by 6 m hai; Stall B 2 m by 8 m hai. Kiska floor area zyada hai?
hints: Does equal rope length guarantee equal floor area?
Find each area by multiplying its two sides.
A: 4 × 6; B: 2 × 8. Larger area: ___.
Stall A: its area is 24 sq m, versus Stall B’s 16 sq m.

openers.prompt_en: A rectangular school notice board is divided by a strip running from one corner to the opposite corner. If one triangular section covers 15 sq dm, what area does the other triangular section cover?
openers.prompt_hi: School ka rectangular notice board ek kone se opposite kone tak strip laga kar divide kiya gaya hai. Ek triangular section ka area 15 sq dm hai. Doosre triangular section ka area kya hoga?
hints: What does the corner-to-corner strip do to the rectangle?
Imagine turning one triangular section to fit over the other.
The second section has ___ area as the first.
15 sq dm; the diagonal makes two equal-area triangles.

openers.prompt_en: A right-angled triangular badge has two sides meeting at the right angle measuring 7 cm and 4 cm. What is its area?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek right-angled triangular badge mein right angle par milne wali sides 7 cm aur 4 cm hain. Iska area kya hai?
hints: Which two sides could form a rectangle around the badge?
The badge takes half the area of that rectangle.
14 sq cm; half of 7 × 4 is 14.

harder.prompt_en: A rectangular phone screen is split from its top-left corner to its bottom-right corner. Why do the two triangular regions have equal area: because they fit exactly when one is turned, or because every triangle has equal area?
harder.prompt_hi: Phone ki rectangular screen top-left se bottom-right kone tak divide hui hai. Dono triangular regions ka area barabar kyun hai: kyunki ek ko ghumane par woh doosre par exactly fit hota hai, ya kyunki har triangle ka area barabar hota hai?
harder.answer: They fit exactly when one is turned
acceptable: One triangle fits on the other
Ek ko ghumane par doosre par fit hota hai
hints: Could triangles of completely different sizes all have equal area?
Think about whether these two pieces would overlap perfectly.
Choose the reason based on how the pieces ___.
They fit exactly when one is turned; matching pieces have equal area.

verified.solverAnswer: They fit exactly when one is turned.

harder.prompt_en: A right-angled triangular stage banner has sides of 1.2 m and 80 cm meeting at the right angle. What is its area in square centimetres?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek right-angled triangular stage banner mein right angle par milne wali sides 1.2 m aur 80 cm hain. Iska area square centimetres mein kya hoga?
acceptable: chaar hazaar aath sau sq cm
hints: Are both lengths in the same unit?
Convert metres to centimetres before finding half the rectangle’s area.
Area = (___ cm × 80 cm) ÷ 2.
4,800 sq cm; half of 120 × 80 gives the banner’s area.

harder.prompt_en: In a 12 cm by 5 cm rectangle, a triangle uses the whole bottom edge as its base and has its third corner anywhere on the top edge. Why is its area always 30 sq cm: the height stays 5 cm, or the sloping sides stay equal?
harder.prompt_hi: 12 cm by 5 cm ke rectangle mein triangle ki base poori bottom edge hai aur teesra kona top edge par kahin bhi hai. Iska area hamesha 30 sq cm kyun hai: height 5 cm rehti hai, ya sloping sides barabar rehti hain?
hints: Does moving the top corner change its distance from the base?
Area depends on the base and perpendicular distance to it.
The base is fixed, and the ___ is fixed too.
The height stays 5 cm; half of 12 × 5 is always 30 sq cm.

openers.prompt_en: A 3-metre charging cable is marked into 12 equal sections. What fraction of the entire cable is one section?
openers.prompt_hi: 3-metre charging cable par 12 barabar sections mark kiye gaye hain. Ek section poori cable ka kaunsa fraction hai?
hints: What counts as the whole here?
A unit fraction names one equal part of the whole.
One section is 1/___ of the entire cable.
1/12, because the cable has 12 equal sections.

openers.prompt_en: Two students travel parts of the same metro route. Asha travels 1/7 of it; Kabir travels 1/9 of it. Who travels farther?
openers.prompt_hi: Do students same metro route ka kuch hissa travel karte hain. Asha 1/7 aur Kabir 1/9 route travel karta hai. Kaun zyada door jaata hai?
hints: Are both fractions of the same route?
With one whole, fewer equal parts make each part larger.
Compare the denominators: the smaller one gives the ___ distance.
Asha, because 1/7 of the same route exceeds 1/9.

harder.prompt_en: A school has 1 litre of paint for a mural. Each identical pot holds 125 mL, and all the paint fills the pots exactly. What fraction of the paint is in one pot?
harder.prompt_hi: School mural ke liye 1 litre paint hai. Har ek jaise pot mein 125 mL aata hai, aur saara paint pots mein exactly bhar jaata hai. Ek pot mein paint ka kaunsa fraction hai?
hints: How many millilitres are in the whole supply?
Find how many equal pots the whole supply fills.
Number of pots = ___ ÷ 125; one pot is one equal part.
1/8, because 1,000 mL fills eight equal pots.

harder.prompt_en: Meera walks 1/12 of a 3 km trail. Dev walks 1/8 of a 2 km trail. Who walks farther: Meera, Dev, or neither?
harder.prompt_hi: Meera 3 km trail ka 1/12 chalti hai. Dev 2 km trail ka 1/8 chalta hai. Kaun zyada door chalta hai: Meera, Dev, ya neither?
hints: Are these fractions taken from wholes of equal length?
Find each distance before comparing the fractions.
Meera walks 3 ÷ 12 km; Dev walks 2 ÷ ___ km.
Neither; each walks 250 m despite different fractions.

harder.prompt_en: For a school event, 7 metres of ribbon are shared equally among 4 banners. How many metres of ribbon does each banner get?
harder.prompt_hi: School event mein 7 metre ribbon 4 banners mein barabar baanti jaati hai. Har banner ko kitne metre ribbon milegi?
hints: How much ribbon is there in total?
Share every metre into four equal parts.
Each banner receives ___ quarter-metre pieces.
7/4 m; each banner gets one quarter from each of seven metres.

openers.prompt_en: A running track’s distance markers show kilometres. Between which two whole-kilometre markers does 7/3 km lie: 1 and 2, or 2 and 3?
openers.prompt_hi: Running track par distance markers kilometres mein hain. 7/3 km kin do poore kilometre markers ke beech aayega: 1 aur 2, ya 2 aur 3?
hints: How many thirds make one whole kilometre?
Group the thirds into complete kilometres first.
Seven thirds make ___ complete kilometres, with some distance left.
2 and 3: six thirds make two kilometres, with one third left.

openers.prompt_en: A recipe uses 11/3 cups of flour. Write this quantity as a mixed fraction.
openers.prompt_hi: Ek recipe mein 11/3 cups flour lagta hai. Is quantity ko mixed fraction mein likho.
hints: How many complete cups can you make?
Divide the numerator by the denominator; keep the remainder.
11 ÷ 3 gives ___ whole cups and a remainder.
3 2/3 cups: three full cups use nine thirds.

harder.prompt_en: Two players run 17/6 km and 2 3/4 km. On a number line, which distance is farther right: 17/6 km or 2 3/4 km?
harder.prompt_hi: Do players 17/6 km aur 2 3/4 km daudte hain. Number line par kaunsa distance zyada right mein hoga: 17/6 km ya 2 3/4 km?
hints: Do both distances pass the same whole-kilometre mark?
Compare only the fractional parts after that mark.
Use twelfths: the first fractional part is ___ twelfths.
17/6 km is farther right: its fractional part exceeds three-quarters.

harder.prompt_en: A school banner needs 4 5/7 metres of ribbon. Write its length as an improper fraction in metres.
harder.prompt_hi: School banner ke liye 4 5/7 metre ribbon chahiye. Is length ko metres mein improper fraction ke roop mein likho.
hints: How many sevenths are in four whole metres?
Multiply whole metres by the denominator, then add the numerator.
The new numerator is 4 × 7 + ___; keep the denominator.
33/7 m: four wholes give 28 sevenths; add five more.

harder.prompt_en: A train journey lasts 15/8 hours. How long is that in hours and minutes?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek train journey 15/8 hours ki hai. Yeh hours aur minutes mein kitni hogi?
acceptable: one hour fifty-two minutes thirty seconds
hints: How many full hours fit into the journey?
Convert the remaining fraction of an hour into minutes.
After the full hour, convert ___ of an hour using 60 minutes.
1 hour 52 minutes 30 seconds: seven-eighths of an hour is 52½ minutes.

openers.prompt_en: Two equal-length metro routes are shown on maps. One map marks 2/3 of its route; the other marks 4/6. Do the marked parts represent the same distance or different distances?
openers.prompt_hi: Do metro routes ki lambai barabar hai. Ek map par route ka 2/3 hissa mark hai, doosre par 4/6. Kya marked hisson ki doori same hai ya alag?
hints: Could both marks reach the same point along equal routes?
Compare the fractions by changing their parts to a common size.
Write 2/3 as __/6, then compare the marks.
Same distance: 2/3 and 4/6 are equivalent fractions.

openers.prompt_en: A phone shows that 3/5 of this month's data is used. To show the same amount in twentieths, fill the blank: 3/5 = ?/20.
openers.prompt_hi: Phone dikhata hai ki is mahine ka 3/5 data use hua hai. Usi amount ko twentieths mein dikhane ke liye bharo: 3/5 = ?/20.
hints: What changes the denominator from 5 to 20?
Multiply the numerator and denominator by the same number.
5 × __ = 20, so 3 × __ gives the missing numerator.
12: multiply both 3 and 5 by 4.

harder.prompt_en: At a school event, 12/16 seats in one equal-sized section and 15/20 seats in another are filled. Are the filled portions equal or different? Why?
harder.prompt_hi: School event mein ek section ki 12/16 seats aur utne hi bade doosre section ki 15/20 seats bhari hain. Kya bhare hue hisse barabar hain ya alag? Kyon?
hints: Can you compare the sections without counting individual seats?
Reduce each fraction before comparing the portions.
12/16 reduces to __; check whether 15/20 does too.
Equal: both fractions reduce to 3/4.

harder.prompt_en: A cricket scoreboard shows 7/9 of a team's runs came from boundaries. A graphic needs an equivalent fraction with 45 as its denominator. What numerator should it show?
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket scoreboard ke hisaab se team ke 7/9 runs boundaries se aaye. Graphic mein isi fraction ka denominator 45 chahiye. Numerator kya hoga?
hints: How many times does 9 fit into 45?
Use that same multiplier on the numerator.
9 × __ = 45; therefore 7 × __ is needed.
35: multiplying both parts of 7/9 by 5 gives 35/45.

harder.prompt_en: In a school survey, 84 out of 126 students chose the metro for a trip. Write the fraction 84/126 in lowest terms.
harder.prompt_hi: School survey mein 126 mein se 84 students ne trip ke liye metro chuni. Fraction 84/126 ko lowest terms mein likho.
hints: What number divides both 84 and 126?
Keep dividing both parts by common factors until none remain.
84 ÷ __ and 126 ÷ __ give the simplest fraction.
2/3: dividing both 84 and 126 by 42 leaves no common factor.

openers.prompt_en: Two equal-sized bottles are filled with juice. One is 4/9 full and the other is 7/9 full. Which bottle has more juice: 4/9 or 7/9?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek jaise size ki do bottles mein juice hai. Ek 4/9 bhari hai aur doosri 7/9 bhari hai. Kis bottle mein zyada juice hai: 4/9 ya 7/9?
hints: Are the bottles the same size?
With equal-sized ninths, compare how many parts are filled.
The bottle with ___ filled ninths has more juice.
7/9; it has more filled ninths.

openers.prompt_en: Riya downloaded 2/3 of a game, and Kabir downloaded 3/5 of the same game. Who downloaded more: Riya or Kabir?
openers.prompt_hi: Riya ne ek game ka 2/3 download kiya aur Kabir ne usi game ka 3/5. Zyada kisne download kiya: Riya ya Kabir?
hints: Can you compare these fractions using equal-sized parts?
Rewrite both fractions with a common denominator.
Riya; 10/15 is greater than 9/15.

harder.prompt_en: At a school event, two equal-sized water tanks are 11/14 and 11/18 full. Which tank has more water, and why? Answer using the fraction and one short reason.
harder.prompt_hi: School event mein ek jaise size ke do water tanks 11/14 aur 11/18 bhare hain. Kis tank mein zyada paani hai, aur kyun? Fraction aur ek chhota reason batao.
harder.answer: 11/14; with the same numerator, fourteenths are larger parts than eighteenths.
acceptable: 11/14, because its equal parts are bigger
11 by 14; smaller denominator means larger parts
hints: What stays the same in these two fractions?
For equal wholes, fewer divisions make each part larger.
Both have eleven parts; the parts in ___ are larger.
11/14; fourteenths are larger than eighteenths.

verified.solverAnswer: 11/14, because when numerators are the same, the fraction with the smaller denominator is larger.
