harder.prompt_en: Two metro routes each have the same total number of stops. Route A has passed 7/12 of its stops; Route B has passed 5/8. Which route has passed a greater fraction of its stops: A or B?
harder.prompt_hi: Do metro routes mein total stops barabar hain. Route A apne 7/12 stops paar kar chuka hai; Route B 5/8. Kis route ne apne stops ka zyada hissa paar kiya hai: A ya B?
hints: How could you make the parts the same size?
Use a common denominator for twelfths and eighths.
In twenty-fourths, Route A is ___ and Route B is ___.
Route B; 15/24 is greater than 14/24.

harder.prompt_en: For a school concert, Hall A has sold 11/20 of its tickets and Hall B has sold 4/9. Without finding a common denominator, which hall has sold a greater fraction: A or B?
harder.prompt_hi: School concert ke liye Hall A ke 11/20 tickets aur Hall B ke 4/9 tickets bik chuke hain. Common denominator nikale bina, kis hall ke tickets ka zyada hissa bika hai: A ya B?
hints: Which familiar fraction lies between these two amounts?
Check whether each amount is above or below one-half.
Hall A is ___ one-half; Hall B is ___ one-half.
Hall A; it is above one-half, while Hall B is below.

openers.prompt_en: Meera used 3/10 GB of phone data for a video call and 4/10 GB for a match stream. How much data did she use altogether?
openers.prompt_hi: Meera ne video call ke liye 3/10 GB aur match stream ke liye 4/10 GB data use kiya. Kul kitna data use hua?
hints: Are both amounts measured in the same-sized parts?
With equal denominators, combine the numerators.
The total is (3 + 4)/___ GB.
7/10 GB; add the numerators and keep the denominator.

openers.prompt_en: For a school event, Rohan mixes 1/3 litre of orange juice with 1/6 litre of lemon juice. How much juice is in the mix?
openers.prompt_hi: School event ke liye Rohan 1/3 litre orange juice aur 1/6 litre lemon juice milata hai. Mix mein kul kitna juice hai?
hints: Can you express both amounts using equal-sized parts?
Rewrite thirds and sixths with a common denominator.
1/2 litre; 2/6 plus 1/6 simplifies to 1/2.

harder.prompt_en: A metro card had ₹11/15 of its starting balance left. A trip used ₹4/15 of the starting balance, then a refund added ₹2/15. What fraction of the starting balance is left?
harder.prompt_hi: Metro card mein shuru ke balance ka 11/15 bacha tha. Ek trip mein 4/15 kharch hua, phir 2/15 refund mila. Ab shuru ke balance ka kitna hissa bacha hai?
hints: Which amount leaves the card, and which comes back?
Subtract the trip cost, then add the refund.
The remaining fraction is (11 − 4 + 2)/___.
3/5; the numerator becomes 9, so 9/15 simplifies.

harder.prompt_en: A recipe needs 5/6 cup of oats. Priya has already added 1/4 cup. How much more must she add?
harder.prompt_hi: Recipe mein 5/6 cup oats chahiye. Priya ne 1/4 cup daal diya hai. Use aur kitna daalna hoga?
hints: Is this an addition or a subtraction?
Change both fractions into twelfths before subtracting.
7/12 cup; subtract 3/12 from 10/12.

harder.prompt_en: A school bought 5 1/4 metres of cloth for team flags and used 2 2/3 metres. How much cloth remains?
harder.prompt_hi: School ne team flags ke liye 5 1/4 metre kapda kharida aur 2 2/3 metre use kiya. Kitna kapda bacha?
acceptable: do aur saat bata baarah metre
hints: Which mixed number should you subtract from the other?
Use twelfths for the fractional parts; regroup one whole if needed.
2 7/12 metres; subtract wholes and twelfths after regrouping.

openers.prompt_en: On a circular school badge, P is marked at the centre and Q on the edge. What is the line segment PQ called?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek gol school badge mein P centre par aur Q kinaare par hai. Line segment PQ ko kya kehte hain?
hints: Where are the two ends of PQ?
Circle segments have names based on where their endpoints lie.
Centre se edge tak ka segment ___ kehlata hai.
Radius: it joins the centre to a point on the circle.

openers.prompt_en: Meera wants to draw a circular design 12 cm across on a notebook cover. How wide should she set her compass?
openers.prompt_hi: Meera notebook cover par 12 cm chaurai ka gol design banana chahti hai. Compass ko kitna kholna chahiye?
hints: Does the compass opening span the whole circle?
The opening goes from the centre to the edge.
Compass opening = 12 ÷ ___ cm.
6 cm: the compass opening is half the distance across.

harder.prompt_en: On a circular cricket practice target, AB and CD both join points on the edge. AB is 18 cm long and passes through the centre; CD is 14 cm long. Which is the diameter: AB or CD?
harder.prompt_hi: Gol cricket practice target mein AB aur CD dono kinaare ke points ko jodte hain. AB 18 cm lamba hai aur centre se guzarta hai; CD 14 cm hai. Diameter kaunsa hai: AB ya CD?
hints: Which segment crosses the marked centre?
A diameter must pass through the centre.
Centre se guzarne wala segment ___ hai.
AB: it joins two points on the circle through the centre.

harder.prompt_en: For a poster, you need a short arc from a circle 10 cm across. With the compass point fixed at O, what opening should you use before drawing the arc?
harder.prompt_hi: Poster ke liye 10 cm chaurai wale circle ka chhota arc banana hai. Compass ki nok O par fix karke, arc banane se pehle compass kitna khologe?
hints: What distance does the compass opening represent?
An arc uses the same opening as its full circle.
Opening = circle ki chaurai ÷ ___ cm.
5 cm: the opening is half the circle’s width.

harder.prompt_en: A metro map marks stations A and B exactly 4 km from hub H. A planner draws a circle centred at H with radius 4 km. Will both stations lie on the circle? Answer yes or no.
harder.prompt_hi: Metro map par stations A aur B, hub H se bilkul 4 km door hain. Planner H ko centre rakhkar 4 km radius ka circle banata hai. Kya dono stations circle par honge? Haan ya nahin?
acceptable: both stations will lie on the circle
hints: How far is each station from H?
Compare each distance with the circle’s radius.
Dono distances radius ke ___ hain.
Yes: both stations are exactly one radius from H.

openers.prompt_en: A rectangular school notice board has a top edge of 80 cm and a left edge of 50 cm. How long is its bottom edge?
openers.prompt_hi: School ke rectangular notice board ka upar wala edge 80 cm aur left edge 50 cm hai. Neeche wala edge kitna lamba hoga?
hints: Which edge is opposite the bottom edge?
Opposite sides of a rectangle have equal lengths.
Bottom edge = length of the ___ edge.
80 cm; the bottom and top edges are opposite sides.

openers.prompt_en: To draw a 4 cm square tile, Riya draws AB = 4 cm and a perpendicular line at A. What length should she mark from A on that line to locate the next corner?
openers.prompt_hi: 4 cm side wali square tile banane ke liye Riya AB = 4 cm kheenchti hai aur A par perpendicular line banati hai. Agla corner paane ke liye us line par A se kitni length mark kare?
hints: How do adjacent sides of a square compare?
The new corner lies one side-length from A.
Mark a length equal to AB: ___ cm.
4 cm; every side of a square equals AB.

harder.prompt_en: A rectangular cricket practice mat has a perimeter of 34 m. Its longer side is 11 m. What is the shorter side?
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket practice ki rectangular mat ka perimeter 34 m hai. Uski lambi side 11 m hai. Chhoti side kitni hogi?
hints: How many times does each side length appear in the perimeter?
Half the perimeter is one long side plus one short side.
Short side = half the perimeter − ___ side.
6 m; half of 34 m is 17 m, and 17 − 11 = 6.

harder.prompt_en: You have drawn AB = 9 cm as one side of a 9 cm by 6 cm rectangular games poster. What construction should you do next at A and B?
harder.prompt_hi: 9 cm by 6 cm ke rectangular games poster ki ek side AB = 9 cm bana li hai. Ab A aur B par construction ka agla step kya hoga?
harder.answer: Draw perpendiculars at A and B, then mark 6 cm on each
acceptable: Make right angles at A and B and mark 6 cm on both
Draw perpendicular lines at both ends and measure 6 cm on each
hints: What must the angles at A and B be?
Construct lines at right angles before locating the remaining corners.
At A and B, draw ___ lines; then mark the shorter side.
Draw perpendiculars at A and B and mark 6 cm on each.

harder.prompt_en: A metal frame has four 7 cm sides. A set square shows that one corner is not a right angle. Is the frame a square or a rhombus?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek metal frame ki chaaron sides 7 cm hain. Set square se pata chalta hai ki ek corner right angle nahi hai. Frame square hai ya rhombus?
hints: Are equal side lengths enough to confirm a square?
A square also needs right angles at its corners.
Equal sides without a right angle identify a ___.
Rhombus; its sides are equal, but the checked corner is not a right angle.

openers.prompt_en: A rectangular phone screen has corners P, Q, R, S in order. Its diagonals meet at O. If PR is 14 cm, how long is PO?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek rectangular phone screen ke corners P, Q, R, S kram mein hain. Diagonals O par milte hain. Agar PR 14 cm hai, toh PO kitna hoga?
hints: Where do a rectangle’s diagonals cross each other?
Their crossing point divides each diagonal into equal parts.
7 cm, because O is the midpoint of PR.

openers.prompt_en: On a map, two metro gates are marked A and B. You draw arcs with the same compass opening from each gate. A crossing is marked X. Which distances are equal: XA and XB, or XA and AB?
openers.prompt_hi: Map par do metro gates A aur B hain. Dono gates se compass ki same opening rakhkar arcs banate ho. Arcs X par milte hain. Kaunsi distances barabar hain: XA aur XB, ya XA aur AB?
acceptable: X se A aur X se B
hints: What does the compass opening measure from each gate?
Each arc marks points at a fixed distance from its centre.
At X, distance from A = distance from ___.
XA and XB, because both arcs use the same compass opening.

harder.prompt_en: A rectangular school-event banner has diagonals PR and QS meeting at O. If PO is 9 cm, how long is QS?
harder.prompt_hi: School event ke rectangular banner ke diagonals PR aur QS, O par milte hain. Agar PO 9 cm hai, toh QS kitna lamba hoga?
hints: How is PO related to the whole diagonal PR?
The crossing halves PR, and the two diagonals are equal.
QS = PR = ___ × PO.
18 cm: PR is twice PO, and QS equals PR.

harder.prompt_en: On a plan, points A and B are 12 cm apart. You draw arcs of radius 5 cm from each point. Will the arcs cross: yes or no?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek plan par points A aur B 12 cm door hain. Dono points se 5 cm radius ke arcs banate ho. Kya arcs milenge: haan ya nahin?
hints: How far can each arc reach towards the other point?
Compare the combined reach of both arcs with the gap.
Combined reach = ___ + ___ cm; compare it with 12 cm.
No: their combined reach is 10 cm, less than the 12 cm gap.

harder.prompt_en: Two school entrances A and B are marked on a ground plan. A drinking-water point must be equally far from both entrances and lie on the boundary line along the north edge. Where should it go?
harder.prompt_hi: Ground plan par school ke do entrances A aur B hain. Paani ka point dono se barabar door aur north edge ki boundary line par hona chahiye. Use kahan rakhen?
harder.answer: Where the north boundary intersects the perpendicular bisector of AB
acceptable: north boundary aur AB ke perpendicular bisector ka intersection
where the equal-distance line for A and B meets the north boundary
hints: What line contains points equally far from A and B?
Find that line first, then apply the boundary condition.
Choose where the north boundary meets the ___ of AB.
At the boundary’s intersection with AB’s perpendicular bisector; its points are equidistant.

verified.solverAnswer: On the perpendicular bisector of AB where it meets the north edge.

openers.prompt_en: A school pennant is an isosceles triangle. Would folding it from the top vertex to the midpoint of its base make the two halves match exactly? Say yes or no.
openers.prompt_hi: School ka pennant ek isosceles triangle hai. Upar wale kone se base ke beech tak fold karne par kya dono halves bilkul milenge? Haan ya nahin?
hints: What must happen to the edges when you fold?
Think about the two equal sides of an isosceles triangle.
After folding, one equal side lands on the other, so the answer is ___.
Yes. The equal sides and both halves match.

openers.prompt_en: On a poster, a capital A has equal sloping strokes and a centred crossbar. Does a vertical line through its centre give a line of symmetry? Say yes or no.
openers.prompt_hi: Poster par capital A ke dono tirchhe strokes barabar hain aur crossbar centre mein hai. Kya centre se guzarti vertical line, line of symmetry hai? Haan ya nahin?
hints: How would the letter look in a vertical mirror?
Compare the strokes on either side of the proposed line.
If the strokes and crossbar overlap after folding, the answer is ___.
Yes. Both sides of this A overlap when folded.

harder.prompt_en: For a triangular sports flag with three unequal sides, a line joins one vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side. Why is that line not a line of symmetry, even though it makes two equal-area parts?
harder.prompt_hi: Teen alag lambai wali sides ke triangular sports flag mein ek line kone ko saamne wali side ke midpoint se jodti hai. Barabar area ke do parts banne par bhi yeh line of symmetry kyon nahin hai?
harder.answer: The two parts do not overlap when folded along the line.
acceptable: the halves are not mirror images
fold karne par dono parts nahin milte
dono halves mirror images nahin hain
hints: Does equal area guarantee that folded parts match?
A symmetry line needs matching shapes across the fold.
Here, folding along the line makes the two parts ___.
They do not overlap; equal area alone does not make mirror halves.

verified.solverAnswer: The two halves are not congruent, just equal in area.
verified.note: Solver says not congruent; key is not mirror images

harder.prompt_en: A regular octagon on a school logo has eight equal sides and eight equal angles. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
harder.prompt_hi: School logo ke regular octagon ki aath sides aur aath angles barabar hain. Iski kitni lines of symmetry hain?
hints: Which lines pass through opposite corners?
Also check lines through midpoints of opposite sides.
Count both types without repeating any: total = ___.
8. Four pass through opposite corners and four through opposite side-midpoints.

harder.prompt_en: On a grid for a game design, the vertical mirror line is x = 5. A dot is at (2, 4). What coordinates must its matching dot have?
harder.prompt_hi: Game design ke grid par vertical mirror line x = 5 hai. Ek dot (2, 4) par hai. Uska matching dot kin coordinates par hoga?
hints: How far is the dot from the mirror line?
Keep its height unchanged; move equally far to the other side.
Matching x-coordinate = mirror line’s x-coordinate + ___; y stays unchanged.
(8, 4). It is equally far across the line, at the same height.

openers.prompt_en: A plain rectangular metro ticket is not a square. If you turn it halfway around its centre, will its outline match its starting position? Answer yes or no.
openers.prompt_hi: Ek plain rectangular metro ticket square nahi hai. Centre ke around aadha ghumane par kya uski outline pehle jaisi dikhegi? Haan ya nahi?
hints: Where will each corner move after a half-turn?
Compare the outline, not the ticket’s printed side.
After a half-turn, the long sides lie along ___.
Yes. A half-turn puts the rectangular outline back in place.

openers.prompt_en: A round badge has three identical dots equally spaced around its centre and no other marks. What is its smallest angle of rotational symmetry?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek round badge par centre ke around teen ek jaise dots barabar doori par hain, aur koi mark nahi hai. Iska sabse chhota rotational symmetry angle kya hai?
hints: How many equal gaps are there between the dots?
A full turn is shared equally among those gaps.
Smallest matching turn = 360° ÷ ___.
120°. Three equal gaps divide a full turn into three turns.

harder.prompt_en: A rectangular school banner has identical red dots only at its top-left and bottom-right corners. Does the whole design have rotational symmetry: yes or no? Ignore the back of the banner.
harder.prompt_hi: Ek rectangular school banner par sirf top-left aur bottom-right corners mein ek jaise laal dots hain. Kya poore design mein rotational symmetry hai? Haan ya nahi? Banner ki back side ignore karo.
hints: Check where both dots go during a half-turn.
The outline and the markings must both match.
After a half-turn, each red dot moves to ___.
Yes. The two dots exchange places and the rectangle matches.

harder.prompt_en: Twelve lamps are equally spaced around a circular stage. Every third lamp is red; the rest are white. What are the design’s smallest matching turn and its order of rotational symmetry?
harder.prompt_hi: Circular stage ke around 12 lamps barabar doori par hain. Har teesra lamp laal hai, baaki safed hain. Design ka sabse chhota matching turn aur rotational symmetry ka order kya hai?
hints: How many lamp positions separate neighbouring red lamps?
First find the angle between adjacent lamps.
Matching turn = ___ lamp gaps; order = 360° ÷ that turn.
90° and order 4. The red-lamp pattern repeats every three gaps.

harder.prompt_en: A logo has four identical bent arms spaced equally around a centre. Each arm bends clockwise, like a pinwheel. Which describes it: rotation only, line only, both, or neither?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek logo mein centre ke around barabar doori par chaar ek jaise mude hue arms hain. Har arm clockwise mudta hai, pinwheel ki tarah. Kya sahi hai: sirf rotation, sirf line, dono, ya koi nahi?
acceptable: rotational symmetry but no line symmetry
hints: What happens when each arm takes the next arm’s place?
Now imagine folding the logo along a line.
Turning preserves the bend direction; reflection would ___.
Rotation only. A turn matches the arms, but reflection reverses their bends.

openers.prompt_en: A metro card has ₹200. A ride deducts ₹35. Write the change in the card balance as a signed integer in rupees.
openers.prompt_hi: Metro card mein ₹200 hain. Ek ride ke ₹35 katte hain. Card balance mein hue badlav ko signed integer mein likho.
hints: Did the card balance rise or fall?
A decrease is written with a negative sign.
Balance change = ___ ₹35.
−₹35; the fare reduced the balance.

openers.prompt_en: An online game account has no coins left, and Aarav owes the game club 12 coins. Taking no debt as 0, write his coin balance as an integer.
openers.prompt_hi: Online game account mein coins khatam hain, aur Aarav ko game club ko 12 coins dene hain. Koi udhaar na hona 0 maankar, uska coin balance integer mein likho.
hints: Is owing coins the same as owning coins?
A debt lies below a zero balance.
Coin balance = ___ 12.
−12; owing coins gives a negative balance.

harder.prompt_en: In a school quiz, Meera gains 25 points, then loses 40 points. What is her total signed change in points?
harder.prompt_hi: School quiz mein Meera ko 25 points milte hain, phir 40 points kat jaate hain. Uske points mein kul signed badlav kya hai?
hints: Which change is larger in size?
Combine the gain and loss using their signs.
Signed change = (+25) + (−40) = ___.
−15 points; the loss exceeds the gain by 15.

harder.prompt_en: At dawn in Srinagar, the temperature is −4 °C. By night, it falls another 7 °C. Write the night temperature as an integer.
harder.prompt_hi: Srinagar mein subah temperature −4 °C hai. Raat tak yeh 7 °C aur girta hai. Raat ka temperature integer mein likho.
hints: Does a further fall move towards or away from zero?
Start below zero, then move seven more units down.
Night temperature = −4 − 7 = ___ °C.
−11 °C; falling further makes it more negative.

harder.prompt_en: A sea-depth map sets sea level at 0 m and marks a cable at −18 m. Why is its position written with a minus sign?
harder.prompt_hi: Sea-depth map par sea level 0 m hai aur ek cable −18 m par dikhayi gayi hai. Uski position ke aage minus sign kyun hai?
harder.answer: It is 18 m below sea level.
hints: What does the map use as its starting level?
The sign shows which side of the reference level.
The cable is ___ the 0 m level.
It is 18 m below sea level; minus marks that direction.

openers.prompt_en: On a temperature number line, where is −4 °C from 0 °C? Say the direction and number of unit steps.
openers.prompt_hi: Temperature number line par −4 °C, 0 °C se kidhar hai? Direction aur unit steps ki sankhya batao.
hints: Do readings below zero go left or right?
Negative readings lie on the lower-value side of zero.
From zero, move ___ unit steps towards lower readings.
4 steps left; −4 is four units below zero.

openers.prompt_en: Two game accounts show balances of −₹6 and −₹9. Which balance is greater?
openers.prompt_hi: Do game accounts mein balances −₹6 aur −₹9 hain. Kaunsa balance bada hai?
hints: Which balance would sit farther right on a number line?
Among negative numbers, the one closer to zero is greater.
Compare their positions: the balance farther right is ___.
−₹6; it is closer to zero than −₹9.

harder.prompt_en: A game's score marker starts at −8 on a number line. A penalty moves it 5 places left. What number does it reach?
harder.prompt_hi: Game ka score marker number line par −8 se shuru hota hai. Penalty se woh 5 jagah left jaata hai. Ab kis number par hai?
hints: Does moving left increase or decrease the score?
Start at the marked negative position and count leftward.
Five places left from −8 gives ___.
−13; moving left five places decreases −8 by five.

harder.prompt_en: A trek map gives three checkpoints' heights relative to camp: A is −18 m, B is −25 m, and C is −11 m. Which checkpoint is highest?
harder.prompt_hi: Trek map par camp ke comparison mein checkpoints ki heights hain: A −18 m, B −25 m, aur C −11 m. Sabse ooncha checkpoint kaunsa hai?
hints: Which height is greatest on a number line?
The greatest negative height is nearest to zero.
Of the three heights, ___ is nearest to zero.
C; −11 m is greater than the other two heights.

harder.prompt_en: On a number line, a metro lift's starting level is −14 and its ending level is 9. How many unit steps apart are these levels?
harder.prompt_hi: Number line par metro lift ka starting level −14 aur ending level 9 hai. Dono levels ke beech kitne unit steps hain?
hints: Does the journey cross zero?
Count steps to zero, then steps beyond zero.
The total distance is the two parts added: ___.
23 unit steps; count 14 to zero and 9 more.

openers.prompt_en: In a quiz, Meera earns 6 points and loses 8 points. Use positive and negative tokens to find her score change.
openers.prompt_hi: Quiz mein Meera ko 6 points mile aur 8 points kate. Positive aur negative tokens se uske score ka badlav nikalo.
hints: Which tokens can you pair and cancel?
One positive and one negative token make a zero pair.
After cancelling the pairs, ___ tokens remain.
−2 points; two negative tokens remain.

openers.prompt_en: A lift is on floor 2. It goes down 5 floors. Treat going down as subtracting 5. Which floor does it reach?
openers.prompt_hi: Lift floor 2 par hai. Woh 5 floors neeche jaati hai. Neeche jaana 5 ghataane jaisa samjho. Lift kis floor par pahunchegi?
hints: Where do you start on the number line?
Subtracting a positive number means moving left.
Start at 2; move five places left to ___.
Floor −3; five steps left from 2 land there.

harder.prompt_en: During two kabaddi rounds, a team gets 9 bonus points and 14 penalty points. A bonus is positive; a penalty is negative. After cancelling token pairs, what is the team's total score change?
harder.prompt_hi: Kabaddi ke do rounds mein team ko 9 bonus points aur 14 penalty points mile. Bonus positive hai, penalty negative. Token pairs cancel karne ke baad score mein kul kitna badlav hua?
hints: How many bonus and penalty tokens can cancel?
Match positive tokens with negative tokens to make zero pairs.
Cancel the pairs; ___ penalty tokens remain.
−5 points; five penalty tokens remain unmatched.

harder.prompt_en: A token board shows −4. You must subtract 3 positive tokens, but none are on the board. What total remains after you add zero pairs and remove those tokens?
harder.prompt_hi: Token board par −4 hai. Tumhe 3 positive tokens ghataane hain, par board par koi positive token nahi hai. Zero pairs jodkar un tokens ko hataane ke baad kya total bachega?
hints: How can you put removable positives on the board without changing its value?
Add zero pairs, then remove the requested positive tokens.
After removal, count the negative tokens: ___.
−7; the added zero pairs leave three extra negatives.

harder.prompt_en: A phone-data tracker shows a change of −6 GB. An incorrect charge of −2 GB is removed. Is the corrected change −8 GB or −4 GB? Why?
harder.prompt_hi: Phone-data tracker mein badlav −6 GB dikh raha hai. −2 GB ka galat charge hata diya gaya. Sahi badlav −8 GB hai ya −4 GB? Kyon?
harder.answer: −4 GB; removing a negative charge adds 2 GB
acceptable: minus four GB; the negative charge was removed
hints: Does removing a charge make the balance rise or fall?
Removing a negative amount has the effect of adding.
Write the correction as −6 − (−2) = ___.
−4 GB; subtracting −2 GB adds 2 GB.

verified.solverAnswer: −4 GB, because removing a negative is like adding the opposite
verified.note: Both correct on -4 GB and reason
